tattha  kiñ‍cāpi ayaṃ upaikkhā haiṭṭhāpi tīsu jhānaisu vij‍jati, yathā pana divā sūriyappabhābhibhavā saummabhāvaina ca attanau upakārakattaina vā sabhāgāya rattiyā alābhā divā vij‍jamānāpi candalaikhā aparisuddhā hauti apariyaudātā; aivamayampi tatramajjhattupaikkhācandalaikhā vitak‍kavicārādipac‍canīkadhammataijābhibhavā sabhāgāya ca upaikkhāvaidanārattiyā alābhā vij‍jamānāpi paṭhamādijjhānabhaidaisu aparisuddhā  hauti| tassā ca  aparisuddhāya divā aparisuddhacandalaikhāya pabhā viya sahajātāpi satiādayau aparisuddhāva haunti; tasmā taisu aikampi ‘‘upaikkhāsatipārisuddhi’’nti na vuttaṃ| idha pana vitak‍kādipac‍canīkadhammataijābhibhavābhāvā sabhāgāya ca upaikkhāvaidanārattiyā paṭilābhā ayaṃ tatramajjhattupaikkhācandalaikhā ativiya parisuddhā, tassā parisuddhattā parisuddhacandalaikhāya pabhā viya sahajātāpi satiādayau parisuddhā haunti pariyaudātā, tasmā idamaiva upaikkhāsatipārisuddhinti vuttanti vaiditabbaṃ|

catutthanti gaṇanānupubbatau catutthaṃ| idaṃ catutthaṃ samāpaj‍jatītipi catutthaṃ| jhānanti aittha yathā tatiyaṃ upaikkhādīhi pañ‍caṅgikaṃ; aivamidaṃ upaikkhādīhi tivaṅgikaṃ| yathāha – ‘‘jhānanti upaikkhā, sati cittassaikaggatā’’ti| pariyāyau aiva caisau| ṭhapaitvā pana satiṃ upaikkhaikaggatamaiva gahaitvā nippariyāyaina duvaṅgikamaivaitaṃ hauti| yathāha – ‘‘katamaṃ tasmiṃ samayai duvaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hauti? upaikkhā, cittassaikaggatā’’ti (dha॰ sa॰ 165)| saisaṃ vuttanayamaivāti|

catutthajjhānakathā niṭṭhitā|

pubbainivāsakathā

12. iti imāni cattāri jhānāni kaisañ‍ci cittaikaggatatthāni haunti, kaisañ‍ci vipassanāpādakāni, kaisañ‍ci abhiñ‍ñāpādakāni, kaisañ‍ci niraudhapādakāni, kaisañ‍ci bhavauk‍kamanatthāni| tattha khīṇāsavānaṃ cittaikaggatatthāni haunti, tai hi samāpaj‍jitvā ‘‘aikaggacittā sukhaṃ divasaṃ viharissāmā’’ti  ic‍caivaṃ kasiṇaparikammaṃ katvā aṭṭha samāpattiyau nibbattainti| saikkhaputhuj‍janānaṃ ‘‘samāpattitau vuṭṭhāya samāhitaina cittaina vipassissāmā’’ti nibbattaintānaṃ vipassanāpādakāni haunti| yai pana aṭṭha samāpattiyau nibbattaitvā abhiñ‍ñāpādakaṃ jhānaṃ samāpaj‍jitvā samāpattitau vuṭṭhāya ‘‘aikaupi hutvā bahudhā hautī’’ti vuttanayā abhiñ‍ñāyau patthaintā nibbattainti, taisaṃ abhiñ‍ñāpādakāni haunti| yai pana aṭṭha samāpattiyau nibbattaitvā ‘‘niraudhasamāpattiṃ samāpaj‍jitvā sattāhaṃ acittakā hutvā diṭṭhaiva dhammai niraudhaṃ nibbānaṃ patvā sukhaṃ viharissāmā’’ti nibbattainti, taisaṃ niraudhapādakāni  haunti| yai pana aṭṭha samāpattiyau nibbattaitvā ‘‘aparihīnajjhānā hutvā brahmalaukai uppaj‍jissāmā’’ti nibbattainti, taisaṃ bhavauk‍kamanatthāni haunti|

bhagavatā  panidaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ baudhirukkhamūlai nibbattitaṃ, taṃ tassa vipassanāpādakañ‍caiva ahausi abhiñ‍ñāpādakañ‍ca niraudhapādakañ‍ca sabbakic‍casādhakañ‍ca sabbalaukiyalaukuttaraguṇadāyakanti vaiditabbaṃ| yaisañ‍ca guṇānaṃ dāyakaṃ ahausi, taisaṃ aikadaisaṃ dassaintau ‘‘sau aivaṃ samāhitai cittai’’tiādimāha|

tattha sauti sau ahaṃ| aivanti catutthajjhānak‍kamanidassanamaitaṃ| iminā kamaina catutthajjhānaṃ paṭilabhitvāti vuttaṃ hauti| samāhitaiti iminā catutthajjhānasamādhinā samāhitai| parisuddhaitiādīsu pana upaikkhāsatipārisuddhibhāvaina parisuddhai| parisuddhattāyaiva pariyaudātai, pabhassaraiti vuttaṃ hauti| sukhādīnaṃ pac‍cayānaṃ ghātaina vihatarāgādiaṅgaṇattā anaṅgaṇai| anaṅgaṇattāyaiva ca vigatūpak‍kilaisai; aṅgaṇaina hi cittaṃ upak‍kilissati| subhāvitattā mudubhūtai, vasībhāvappattaiti vuttaṃ hauti| vasai vattamānañhi cittaṃ mudūti vuc‍cati| muduttāyaiva ca kammaniyai, kammakkhamai kammayauggaiti vuttaṃ hauti| mudu hi cittaṃ kammaniyaṃ hauti sudhantamiva suvaṇṇaṃ, tadubhayampi ca subhāvitattā aiva| yathāha – ‘‘nāhaṃ, bhikkhavai, añ‍ñaṃ aikadhammampi samanupassāmi, yaṃ aivaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ mudu ca hauti kammaniyañ‍ca, yathayidaṃ, bhikkhavai, citta’’nti (a॰ ni॰ 1.22)|

aitaisu  parisuddhabhāvādīsu ṭhitattā ṭhitai| ṭhitattāyaiva ānaiñ‍jappattai, acalai niriñ‍janaiti vuttaṃ hauti| mudukammañ‍ñabhāvaina vā attanau vasai ṭhitattā ṭhitai, saddhādīhi pariggahitattā ānaiñ‍jappattai| saddhāpariggahitañhi cittaṃ assaddhiyaina na iñ‍jati, vīriyapariggahitaṃ kausaj‍jaina na iñ‍jati, satipariggahitaṃ pamādaina na iñ‍jati, samādhipariggahitaṃ uddhac‍caina na iñ‍jati, pañ‍ñāpariggahitaṃ avij‍jāya na iñ‍jati, aubhāsagataṃ kilaisandhakāraina na iñ‍jati| imaihi  chahi dhammaihi pariggahitaṃ ānaiñ‍jappattaṃ cittaṃ hauti| aivaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasaman‍nāgataṃ cittaṃ abhinīhārakkhamaṃ hauti abhiñ‍ñāsacchikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ abhiñ‍ñāsacchikiriyāya|

aparau nayau – catutthajjhānasamādhinā samāhitai| nīvaraṇadūrībhāvaina parisuddhai| vitak‍kādisamatik‍kamaina pariyaudātai| jhānappaṭilābhapac‍cayānaṃ pāpakānaṃ icchāvacarānaṃ abhāvaina anaṅgaṇai| abhijjhādīnaṃ cittūpak‍kilaisānaṃ vigamaina vigatūpak‍kilaisai| ubhayampi caitaṃ anaṅgaṇavatthasuttānusāraina (ma॰ ni॰ 1.57 ādayau) vaiditabbaṃ| vasippattiyā mudubhūtai| iddhipādabhāvūpagamaina kammaniyai| bhāvanāpāripūriyā paṇītabhāvūpagamaina ṭhitai ānaiñ‍jappattai| yathā ānaiñ‍jappattaṃ hauti; aivaṃ ṭhitaiti atthau| aivampi aṭṭhaṅgasaman‍nāgataṃ cittaṃ abhinīhārakkhamaṃ hauti abhiñ‍ñāsacchikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ abhiñ‍ñāsacchikiriyāya, pādakaṃ padaṭṭhānabhūtanti atthau|

pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇāyāti aivaṃ abhiñ‍ñāpādakai jātai aitasmiṃ cittai pubbainivāsānussatimhi yaṃ ñāṇaṃ tadatthāya| tattha pubbainivāsauti pubbai atītajātīsu nivutthakkhandhā| nivutthāti ajjhāvutthā anubhūtā attanau santānai uppaj‍jitvā niruddhā nivutthadhammā vā nivutthā, gaucaranivāsaina nivutthā, attanau viñ‍ñāṇaina viñ‍ñātā paricchin‍nā, paraviñ‍ñāṇaviñ‍ñātāpi vā chin‍navaṭumakānussaraṇādīsu| pubbainivāsānussatīti yāya satiyā pubbainivāsaṃ anussarati, sā pubbainivāsānussati| ñāṇanti tāya satiyā sampayuttañāṇaṃ| aivamimassa pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇassa atthāya pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇāya aitassa ñāṇassa adhigamāya pattiyāti vuttaṃ hauti| abhinin‍nāmaisinti abhinīhariṃ|

sauti  sau ahaṃ| anaikavihitanti anaikavidhaṃ, anaikaihi vā pakāraihi pavattitaṃ saṃvaṇṇitanti atthau| pubbainivāsanti samanantarātītaṃ bhavaṃ ādiṃ katvā tattha tattha nivutthasantānaṃ| anussarāmīti ‘‘aikampi jātiṃ dvaipi jātiyau’’ti aivaṃ jātipaṭipāṭiyā anugantvā anugantvā sarāmi, anudaiva vā sarāmi, cittai  abhinin‍nāmitamattai aiva sarāmīti dassaiti| pūritapāramīnañhi mahāpurisānaṃ parikammakaraṇaṃ natthi, taina tai cittaṃ abhinin‍nāmaitvāva saranti| ādikammikakulaputtā pana parikammaṃ katvāva saranti, tasmā taisaṃ vasaina parikammaṃ vattabbaṃ siyā| taṃ pana vuc‍camānaṃ atibhāriyaṃ vinayanidānaṃ karauti, tasmā taṃ na vadāma| atthikaihi pana visuddhimaggai (visuddhi॰ 2.402 ādayau) vuttanayainaiva gahaitabbaṃ| idha pana pāḷimaiva vaṇṇayissāma|

saiyyathidanti āraddhappakāradassanatthai nipātau| tainaiva yvāyaṃ pubbainivāsau āraddhau, tassa pakārappabhaidaṃ dassaintau aikampi jātintiādimāha| tattha aikampi jātinti aikampi paṭisandhimūlaṃ cutipariyausānaṃ aikabhavapariyāpan‍naṃ khandhasantānaṃ| aisa nayau dvaipi jātiyautiādīsu| anaikaipi saṃvaṭṭakappaitiādīsu pana parihāyamānau kappau saṃvaṭṭakappau, vaḍḍhamānau vivaṭṭakappauti vaiditabbau| tattha ca saṃvaṭṭaina saṃvaṭṭaṭṭhāyī gahitau hauti tammūlakattā| vivaṭṭaina ca vivaṭṭaṭṭhāyī| aivañhi sati yāni tāni ‘‘cattārimāni, bhikkhavai, kappassa asaṅkhyaiyyāni| katamāni cattāri? saṃvaṭṭau saṃvaṭṭaṭṭhāyī, vivaṭṭau vivaṭṭaṭṭhāyī’’ti vuttāni tāni sabbāni pariggahitāni haunti|

tattha tayau saṃvaṭṭā – taijausaṃvaṭṭau, āpausaṃvaṭṭau, vāyausaṃvaṭṭauti| tissau saṃvaṭṭasīmā – ābhassarā, subhakiṇhā, vaihapphalāti| yadā kappau taijaina saṃvaṭṭati, ābhassaratau haiṭṭhā agginā ḍayhati| yadā udakaina saṃvaṭṭati, subhakiṇhatau haiṭṭhā udakaina vilīyati| yadā vātaina saṃvaṭṭati, vaihapphalatau haiṭṭhā vātaina viddhaṃsiyati| vitthāratau pana sadāpi aikaṃ buddhakkhaittaṃ vinassati|

buddhakkhaittaṃ nāma tividhaṃ hauti – jātikkhaittaṃ, āṇākkhaittaṃ, visayakkhaittañ‍ca| tattha jātikkhaittaṃ dasasahassacak‍kavāḷapariyantaṃ hauti, yaṃ tathāgatassa paṭisandhiādīsu kampati| āṇākkhaittaṃ  kauṭisatasahassacak‍kavāḷapariyantaṃ hauti| yattha ratanaparittaṃ, khandhaparittaṃ, dhajaggaparittaṃ, āṭānāṭiyaparittaṃ, mauraparittanti imaisaṃ parittānaṃ ānubhāvau pavattati| visayakkhaittaṃ pana anantaṃ aparimāṇaṃ, ‘‘yaṃ  yāvatā vā pana ākaṅkhaiyyā’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 3.81) vuttaṃ yattha yaṃ yaṃ ākaṅkhati taṃ taṃ anussarati| aivamaitaisu tīsu buddhakkhaittaisu aikaṃ āṇākkhaittaṃ vinassati| tasmiṃ pana vinassantai jātikkhaittampi vinaṭṭhamaiva hauti; vinassantañ‍ca aikatauva vinassati, saṇṭhahantampi aikatauva saṇṭhahati| tassa vināsau ca saṇṭhahanañ‍ca visuddhimaggai (visuddhi॰ 2.404) vuttaṃ| atthikaihi tatau gahaitabbaṃ|

yai panaitai saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭā vuttā, aitaisu bhagavā baudhimaṇḍai sammāsambaudhiṃ abhisambujjhanatthāya nisin‍nau anaikaipi saṃvaṭṭakappai anaikaipi vivaṭṭakappai anaikaipi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappai sari| kathaṃ? ‘‘amutrāsi’’ntiādinā nayaina| tattha amutrāsinti amumhi saṃvaṭṭakappai ahaṃ amumhi bhavai vā yauniyā vā gatiyā vā viñ‍ñāṇaṭṭhitiyā vā sattāvāsai vā sattanikāyai vā ahausiṃ| aivaṃnāmauti vaissantarau vā jautipālau vā| aivaṃgauttauti bhaggavau vā gautamau vā| aivaṃvaṇṇauti audātau vā sāmau vā| aivamāhārauti sālimaṃsaudanāhārau vā pavattaphalabhaujanau vā| aivaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvaidīti anaikappakāraina kāyikacaitasikānaṃ sāmisanirāmisādippabhaidānaṃ vā sukhadukkhānaṃ paṭisaṃvaidī| aivamāyupariyantauti aivaṃ vassasataparamāyupariyantau vā caturāsītikappasahassaparamāyupariyantau vā|

sau  tatau cutau amutra udapādinti sau ahaṃ tatau bhavatau yaunitau gatitau viñ‍ñāṇaṭṭhititau sattāvāsatau sattanikāyatau vā cutau, puna amukasmiṃ nāma bhavai yauniyā gatiyā viñ‍ñāṇaṭṭhitiyā sattāvāsai sattanikāyai vā udapādiṃ| tatrāpāsinti atha tatrāpi bhavai yauniyā gatiyā viñ‍ñāṇaṭṭhitiyā sattāvāsai sattanikāyai vā puna ahausiṃ| aivaṃnāmautiādi vuttanayamaiva|

atha vā yasmā amutrāsinti idaṃ anupubbaina ārauhantassa yāvadicchakaṃ saraṇaṃ| sau tatau cutauti paṭinivattantassa pac‍cavaikkhaṇaṃ| tasmā idhūpapan‍nauti imissā idhūpapattiyā anantaraṃ amutra udapādinti tusitabhavanaṃ sandhāyāhāti vaiditabbaṃ| tatrāpāsiṃ aivaṃnāmauti tatrāpi  tusitabhavanai  saitakaitu nāma daivaputtau ahausiṃ| aivaṃgauttauti tāhi daivatāhi saddhiṃ aikagauttau| aivaṃvaṇṇauti suvaṇṇavaṇṇau| aivamāhārauti dibbasudhāhārau| aivaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvaidīti aivaṃ dibbasukhappaṭisaṃvaidī| dukkhaṃ pana saṅkhāradukkhamattamaiva| aivamāyupariyantauti aivaṃ sattapañ‍ñāsavassakauṭisaṭṭhivassasatasahassāyupariyantau| sau tatau cutauti sau ahaṃ tatau tusitabhavanatau cutau| idhūpapan‍nauti idha mahāmāyāya daiviyā kucchimhi nibbattau|

itīti aivaṃ| sākāraṃ sauddaisanti nāmagauttavasaina sauddaisaṃ, vaṇṇādivasaina sākāraṃ| nāmagauttavasaina hi sattau ‘‘dattau, tissau, gautamau’’ti uddisīyati; vaṇṇādīhi audātau, sāmauti nānattatau pañ‍ñāyati; tasmā nāmagauttaṃ uddaisau, itarai ākārā| kiṃ pana buddhāyaiva pubbainivāsaṃ sarantīti? vuc‍catai – na buddhāyaiva, pac‍caikabuddha-buddhasāvaka-titthiyāpi, nau ca khau avisaisaina| titthiyā hi cattālīsaṃyaiva kappai saranti, na tatau paraṃ| kasmā? dubbalapañ‍ñattā| taisañhi nāmarūpaparicchaidavirahatau dubbalā pañ‍ñā hauti| sāvakaisu pana asītimahāsāvakā kappasatasahassaṃ saranti; dvai aggasāvakā aikamasaṅkhyaiyyaṃ satasahassañ‍ca| pac‍caikabuddhā dvai asaṅkhyaiyyāni satasahassañ‍ca| aittakau hi taisaṃ abhinīhārau| buddhānaṃ pana paricchaidau natthi, yāva icchanti tāva saranti| titthiyā ca khandhapaṭipāṭimaiva saranti| paṭipāṭiṃ muñ‍citvā cutipaṭisandhivasaina sarituṃ na sak‍kaunti| taisañhi andhānaṃ viya icchitappadaisauk‍kamanaṃ natthi| sāvakā ubhayathāpi saranti; tathā pac‍caikabuddhā| buddhā pana khandhapaṭipāṭiyāpi cutipaṭisandhivasainapi sīhauk‍kantavasainapi anaikāsu kappakauṭīsu haiṭṭhā vā upari vā yaṃ yaṃ ṭhānaṃ ākaṅkhanti, taṃ sabbaṃ sarantiyaiva|

ayaṃ khau mai brāhmaṇātiādīsu maiti mayā| vij‍jāti viditakaraṇaṭṭhaina vij‍jā| kiṃ viditaṃ  karauti? pubbainivāsaṃ| avij‍jāti tassaiva pubbainivāsassa aviditakaraṇaṭṭhaina tappaṭicchādakamauhau vuc‍cati| tamauti svaiva mauhau tappaṭicchādakaṭṭhaina  ‘‘tamau’’ti vuc‍cati| ālaukauti sāyaivavij‍jā aubhāsakaraṇaṭṭhaina ‘‘ālaukau’’ti vuc‍cati| aittha ca vij‍jā adhigatāti ayaṃ atthau, saisaṃ pasaṃsāvacanaṃ| yaujanā  panaittha – ayaṃ khau mai vij‍jā adhigatā, tassa mai adhigatavij‍jassa avij‍jā vihatā, vinaṭṭhāti atthau| kasmā? yasmā vij‍jā uppan‍nā| aisa nayau itarasmimpi padadvayai|

yathā tanti aittha yathāti aupammatthai| tanti nipātau| satiyā avippavāsaina appamattassa| vīriyātāpaina ātāpinau| kāyai ca jīvitai ca anapaikkhatāya pahitattassa, paisitacittassāti atthau| idaṃ vuttaṃ hauti – yathā appamattassa ātāpinau pahitattassa viharatau avij‍jā vihañ‍ñaiyya vij‍jā uppaj‍jaiyya, tamau vihañ‍ñaiyya ālaukau uppaj‍jaiyya; aivamaiva mama avij‍jā vihatā vij‍jā uppan‍nā, tamau vihatau ālaukau uppan‍nau| aitassa mai padhānānuyaugassa anurūpamaiva phalaṃ laddhanti|

ayaṃ khau mai brāhmaṇa paṭhamā abhinibbhidā ahausi kuk‍kuṭacchāpakassaiva aṇḍakausamhāti ayaṃ khau mama brāhmaṇa pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇamukhatuṇḍakaina pubbai nivutthakkhandhapaṭicchādakaṃ avij‍jaṇḍakausaṃ padālaitvā paṭhamā abhinibbhidā paṭhamā nikkhanti paṭhamā ariyājāti ahausi, kuk‍kuṭacchāpakassaiva mukhatuṇḍakaina vā pādanakhasikhāya vā aṇḍakausaṃ padālaitvā tamhā aṇḍakausamhā abhinibbhidā nikkhanti kuk‍kuṭanikāyai pac‍cājātīti|

pubbainivāsakathā niṭṭhitā|

dibbacakkhuñāṇakathā

13. sau aivaṃ…pai॰… cutūpapātañāṇāyāti cutiyā ca upapātai ca ñāṇāya; yaina ñāṇaina sattānaṃ cuti ca upapātau ca ñāyati, tadatthanti vuttaṃ hauti| cittaṃ abhinin‍nāmaisinti parikammacittaṃ nīhariṃ| sau dibbaina…pai॰… passāmīti aittha pana pūritapāramīnaṃ mahāsattānaṃ parikammakaraṇaṃ natthi| tai hi cittai abhinin‍nāmitamattai aiva dibbaina cakkhunā sattai passanti, ādikammikakulaputtā pana parikammaṃ katvā| tasmā taisaṃ vasaina parikammaṃ vattabbaṃ siyā| taṃ pana vuc‍camānaṃ atibhāriyaṃ vinayanidānaṃ karauti; tasmā taṃ  na vadāma| atthikaihi pana visuddhimaggai (visuddhi॰ 2.411) vuttanayaina gahaitabbaṃ| idha pana pāḷimaiva vaṇṇayissāma|

sauti  sau ahaṃ| dibbainātiādīsu dibbasadisattā dibbaṃ| daivatānañhi sucaritakammanibbattaṃ pittasaimharuhirādīhi apalibuddhaṃ upak‍kilaisavinimuttatāya dūraipi ārammaṇasampaṭicchanasamatthaṃ dibbaṃ pasādacakkhu hauti| idañ‍cāpi vīriyabhāvanābalanibbattaṃ ñāṇacakkhu tādisamaivāti dibbasadisattā dibbaṃ, dibbavihāravasaina paṭiladdhattā attanā ca dibbavihārasan‍nissitattāpi dibbaṃ, ālaukapariggahaina mahājutikattāpi dibbaṃ, tiraukuṭṭādigatarūpadassanaina mahāgatikattāpi dibbaṃ| taṃ sabbaṃ saddasatthānusāraina vaiditabbaṃ| dassanaṭṭhaina cakkhu| cakkhukic‍cakaraṇaina cakkhumivātipi cakkhu| cutūpapātadassanaina diṭṭhivisuddhihaituttā visuddhaṃ| yau hi cutimattamaiva passati na upapātaṃ, sau ucchaidadiṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti| yau upapātamattamaiva passati na cutiṃ, sau navasattapātubhāvadiṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti| yau pana tadubhayaṃ passati, sau yasmā duvidhampi taṃ diṭṭhigataṃ ativattati, tasmāssa taṃ dassanaṃ diṭṭhivisuddhihaitu hauti| tadubhayañ‍ca bhagavā addasa| tainaitaṃ vuttaṃ – ‘‘cutūpapātadassanaina diṭṭhivisuddhihaituttā visuddha’’nti|

aikādasaupak‍kilaisavirahatau vā visuddhaṃ| bhagavatau hi aikādasapak‍kilaisavirahitaṃ dibbacakkhu| yathāha – ‘‘sau khau ahaṃ, anuruddha, ‘vicikicchā cittassa upak‍kilaisau’ti iti viditvā vicikicchaṃ cittassa upak‍kilaisaṃ pajahiṃ| amanasikārau…pai॰… thinamiddhaṃ… chambhitattaṃ… uppilaṃ… duṭṭhul‍laṃ… ac‍cāraddhavīriyaṃ… atilīnavīriyaṃ… abhijappā… nānattasañ‍ñā… ‘atinijjhāyitattaṃ rūpānaṃ cittassa upak‍kilaisau’ti iti viditvā atinijjhāyitattaṃ rūpānaṃ cittassa upak‍kilaisaṃ pajahiṃ| sau khau ahaṃ, anuruddha, appamattau ātāpī pahitattau viharantau aubhāsañhi khau sañ‍jānāmi, na ca rūpāni passāmi| rūpāni hi khau passāmi, na ca aubhāsaṃ sañ‍jānāmī’’ti (ma॰ ni॰ 3.242-243) aivamādi| tadaivaṃ aikādasupak‍kilaisavirahatau  visuddhaṃ|

manussūpacāraṃ atik‍kamitvā rūpadassanaina atik‍kantamānusakaṃ; mānusakaṃ vā maṃsacakkhuṃ atik‍kantattā atik‍kantamānusakanti vaiditabbaṃ| taina dibbaina cakkhunā visuddhaina atik‍kantamānusakaina|

sattai  passāmīti manussamaṃsacakkhunā viya sattai passāmi dakkhāmi aulaukaimi| cavamānai upapaj‍jamānaiti aittha cutikkhaṇai vā upapattikkhaṇai vā  dibbacakkhunā daṭṭhuṃ na sak‍kā, yai pana āsan‍nacutikā idāni cavissanti tai cavamānā| yai ca gahitapaṭisandhikā sampatinibbattā vā, tai upapaj‍jamānāti adhippaitā| tai aivarūpai cavamānai upapaj‍jamānai ca passāmīti dassaiti| hīnaiti mauhanissandayuttattā hīnānaṃ jātikulabhaugādīnaṃ vasaina hīḷitai auhīḷitai uñ‍ñātai avañ‍ñātai| paṇītaiti amauhanissandayuttattā tabbiparītai| suvaṇṇaiti adausanissandayuttattā iṭṭhakantamanāpavaṇṇayuttai| dubbaṇṇaiti dausanissandayuttattā aniṭṭhākantaamanāpavaṇṇayuttai; abhirūpai virūpaitipi atthau| sugataiti sugatigatai, alaubhanissandayuttattā vā aḍḍhai mahaddhanai| duggataiti duggatigatai, laubhanissandayuttattā vā daliddai appan‍napānai| yathākammūpagaiti yaṃ yaṃ kammaṃ upacitaṃ taina taina upagatai| tattha purimaihi ‘‘cavamānai’’tiādīhi dibbacakkhukic‍caṃ vuttaṃ; iminā pana padaina yathākammūpagañāṇakic‍caṃ|

tassa ca ñāṇassa ayamuppattik‍kamau – sau haiṭṭhā nirayābhimukhaṃ ālaukaṃ vaḍḍhaitvā nairayikasattai passati mahantaṃ dukkhamanubhavamānai, taṃ dassanaṃ dibbacakkhukic‍camaiva| sau aivaṃ manasi karauti – ‘‘kin‍nu khau kammaṃ katvā imai sattā aitaṃ dukkhamanubhavantī’’ti? athassa ‘‘idaṃ nāma katvā’’ti taṃ kammārammaṇaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppaj‍jati| tathā upari daivalaukābhimukhaṃ ālaukaṃ vaḍḍhaitvā nandanavana-missakavana-phārusakavanādīsu sattai passati mahāsampattiṃ anubhavamānai| tampi dassanaṃ dibbacakkhukic‍camaiva| sau aivaṃ manasi karauti – ‘‘kin‍nu khau kammaṃ katvā imai sattā aitaṃ sampattiṃ anubhavantī’’ti? athassa ‘‘idaṃ  nāma katvā’’ti taṃkammārammaṇaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppaj‍jati| idaṃ yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ nāma| imassa visuṃ parikammaṃ nāma natthi| yathā cimassa, aivaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassapi| dibbacakkhupādakānaiva hi imāni dibbacakkhunā sahaiva ijjhanti|

kāyaduc‍caritainātiādīsu duṭṭhu caritaṃ duṭṭhaṃ vā caritaṃ kilaisapūtikattāti duc‍caritaṃ; kāyaina duc‍caritaṃ, kāyatau vā uppan‍naṃ duc‍caritanti kāyaduc‍caritaṃ| aivaṃ vacīmanauduc‍caritānipi daṭṭhabbāni| saman‍nāgatāti samaṅgībhūtā| ariyānaṃ upavādakāti buddha-pac‍caikabuddha-buddhasāvakānaṃ ariyānaṃ antamasau gihisautāpan‍nānampi anatthakāmā hutvā antimavatthunā  vā guṇaparidhaṃsanaina vā upavādakā; ak‍kausakā, garahakāti vuttaṃ hauti| tattha ‘‘natthi imaisaṃ samaṇadhammau, assamaṇā aitai’’ti vadantau antimavatthunā upavadati| ‘‘natthi imaisaṃ jhānaṃ vā vimaukkhau vā maggau vā phalaṃ vā’’ti vadantau guṇaparidhaṃsanaina upavadatīti  vaiditabbau| sau ca jānaṃ vā upavadaiyya ajānaṃ vā, ubhayathāpi ariyūpavādauva hauti| bhāriyaṃ kammaṃ saggāvaraṇaṃ maggāvaraṇañ‍ca, sataikicchaṃ pana hauti| tassa ca āvibhāvatthaṃ idaṃ vatthumudāharanti –

‘‘añ‍ñatarasmiṃ kira gāmai aikau thairau ca daharabhikkhu ca piṇḍāya caranti| tai paṭhamagharaiyaiva uḷuṅkamattaṃ uṇhayāguṃ labhiṃsu| thairassa ca kucchivātau atthi| sau cintaisi – ‘ayaṃ yāgu mayhaṃ sappāyā, yāva na sītalā hauti tāva naṃ pivāmī’ti| sau manussaihi ummāratthāya āhaṭai dārukkhandhai nisīditvā taṃ pivi| itarau taṃ jigucchi – ‘aticchātau vatāyaṃ mahal‍lakau amhākaṃ laj‍jitabbakaṃ akāsī’ti| thairau gāmai caritvā vihāraṃ gantvā daharabhikkhuṃ āha – ‘atthi tai, āvusau, imasmiṃ sāsanai patiṭṭhā’ti? ‘āma, bhantai, sautāpan‍nau aha’nti| ‘taina hāvusau, uparimaggatthāya vāyāmaṃ mā akāsi, khīṇāsavau tayā upavaditau’ti| sau taṃ khamāpaisi| tainassa taṃ pākatikaṃ ahausi’’| tasmā yau añ‍ñaupi ariyaṃ upavadati, taina gantvā sacai attanā vuḍḍhatarau hauti, ‘‘ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ idañ‍cidañ‍ca avacaṃ, taṃ mai khamāhī’’ti khamāpaitabbau| sacai navakatarau hauti, vanditvā uk‍kuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añ‍jaliṃ paggahaitvā ‘‘ahaṃ bhantai tumhai idañ‍cidañ‍ca avacaṃ, taṃ mai khamathā’’ti khamāpaitabbau| sacai sau nakkhamati disāpak‍kantau vā hauti, yai tasmiṃ vihārai bhikkhū vasanti taisaṃ santikaṃ gantvā sacai attanā vuḍḍhatarau hauti ṭhitakainaiva, sacai navakatarau uk‍kuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añ‍jaliṃ paggahaitvā ‘‘ahaṃ, bhantai, asukaṃ nāma āyasmantaṃ idañ‍cidañ‍ca avacaṃ, khamatu mai sau āyasmā’’ti aivaṃ vadantaina khamāpaitabbau| sacai sau parinibbutau hauti, parinibbutamañ‍caṭṭhānaṃ gantvā yāva sivathikaṃ gantvāpi khamāpaitabbau| aivaṃ katai saggāvaraṇañ‍ca maggāvaraṇañ‍ca na hauti, pākatikamaiva hauti|

micchādiṭṭhikāti viparītadassanā| micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānāti micchādiṭṭhivasaina samādin‍nanānāvidhakammā, yai ca micchādiṭṭhimūlakaisu kāyakammādīsu añ‍ñaipi  samādapainti| tattha vacīduc‍caritaggahaṇainaiva ariyūpavādai, manauduc‍caritaggahaṇaina ca micchādiṭṭhiyā saṅgahitāyapi imaisaṃ dvin‍naṃ puna vacanaṃ mahāsāvaj‍jabhāvadassanatthanti vaiditabbaṃ| mahāsāvaj‍jau hi ariyūpavādau ānantariyasadisau| yathāha – ‘‘saiyyathāpi, sāriputta, bhikkhu sīlasampan‍nau samādhisampan‍nau pañ‍ñāsampan‍nau diṭṭhaiva dhammai añ‍ñaṃ ārādhaiyya; aivaṃsampadamidaṃ, sāriputta, vadāmi taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaj‍jitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhittau, aivaṃ nirayai’’ti (ma॰ ni॰ 1.149)|

micchādiṭṭhitau  ca mahāsāvaj‍jataraṃ nāma añ‍ñaṃ natthi| yathāha – ‘‘nāhaṃ, bhikkhavai, añ‍ñaṃ aikadhammampi samanupassāmi, aivaṃ mahāsāvaj‍jataraṃ, yathayidaṃ, micchādiṭṭhi| micchādiṭṭhiparamāni, bhikkhavai, vaj‍jānī’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 1.310)|

kāyassa bhaidāti upādin‍nakkhandhaparic‍cāgā| paraṃ maraṇāti tadanantaraṃ abhinibbattakkhandhaggahaṇai| athavā kāyassa bhaidāti jīvitindriyassupacchaidā| paraṃ maraṇāti cuticittatau uddhaṃ| apāyanti aivamādi sabbaṃ nirayavaivacanaṃ| nirayau hi saggamaukkhahaitubhūtā puñ‍ñasammatā ayā apaitattā, sukhānaṃ  vā āyassa abhāvā apāyau| dukkhassa gati paṭisaraṇanti duggati; dausabahulatāya vā duṭṭhaina kammunā nibbattā gatīti duggati| vivasā nipatanti aittha duk‍kaṭakārinauti vinipātau; vinassantā vā aittha nipatanti sambhij‍jamānaṅgapac‍caṅgāti vinipātau| natthi aittha assādasañ‍ñitau ayauti nirayau|

atha vā apāyaggahaṇaina tiracchānayauniṃ dīpaiti| tiracchānayauni hi apāyau, sugatiyā apaitattā; na duggati, mahaisakkhānaṃ nāgarājādīnaṃ sambhavatau| duggatiggahaṇaina paittivisayaṃ dīpaiti| sau hi apāyau caiva duggati ca sugatitau apaitattā, dukkhassa ca gatibhūtattā; na tu vinipātau asurasadisaṃ avinipatitattā| paitamahiddhikānañhi vimānānipi nibbattanti| vinipātaggahaṇaina asurakāyaṃ dīpaiti| sau hi yathāvuttainatthaina apāyau caiva duggati ca sabbasamussayaihi ca vinipatitattā vinipātauti vuc‍cati| nirayaggahaṇaina avīci-ādianaikappakāraṃ nirayamaiva dīpaiti| upapan‍nāti upagatā, tattha abhinibbattāti adhippāyau| vuttavipariyāyaina suk‍kapakkhau vaiditabbau|

ayaṃ  pana visaisau – aittha sugatiggahaṇaina manussagatipi saṅgayhati| saggaggahaṇaina daivagatiyaiva| tattha sundarā gatīti sugati| rūpādivisayaihi suṭṭhu aggauti saggau| sau sabbaupi luj‍janapaluj‍janaṭṭhaina laukauti ayaṃ vacanatthau| vij‍jāti dibbacakkhuñāṇavij‍jā| avij‍jāti sattānaṃ cutipaṭisandhipaṭicchādikā avij‍jā| saisaṃ vuttanayamaiva| ayamaiva haittha visaisau – yathā pubbainivāsakathāyaṃ ‘‘pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇamukhatuṇḍakaina pubbainivutthakkhandhapaacchādakaṃ avij‍jaṇḍakausaṃ padālaitvā’’ti vuttaṃ; aivamidha ‘‘cutūpapātañāṇamukhatuṇḍakaina cutūpapātapaṭicchādakaṃ avij‍jaṇḍakausaṃ padālaitvā’’ti vattabbanti|

dibbacakkhuñāṇakathā niṭṭhitā|

āsavakkhayañāṇakathā

14. sau  aivaṃ samāhitai cittaiti idha vipassanāpādakaṃ catutthajjhānacittaṃ vaiditabbaṃ| āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāyāti arahattamaggañāṇatthāya| arahattamaggau hi āsavavināsanatau āsavānaṃ khayauti vuc‍cati| tatra caitaṃ ñāṇaṃ tappariyāpan‍nattāti| cittaṃ abhinin‍nāmaisinti vipassanācittaṃ abhinīhariṃ| sau idaṃ dukkhanti aivamādīsu ‘‘aittakaṃ dukkhaṃ, na itau bhiyyau’’ti sabbampi dukkhasac‍caṃ sarasalakkhaṇapaṭivaidhaina yathābhūtaṃ abbhañ‍ñāsiṃ jāniṃ paṭivijjhiṃ| tassa ca dukkhassa nibbattikaṃ taṇhaṃ ‘‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayau’’ti, tadubhayampi yaṃ ṭhānaṃ patvā nirujjhati taṃ taisaṃ appavattiṃ nibbānaṃ ‘‘ayaṃ dukkhaniraudhau’’ti, tassa ca sampāpakaṃ ariyamaggaṃ ‘‘ayaṃ dukkhaniraudhagāminī paṭipadā’’ti sarasalakkhaṇapaṭivaidhaina yathābhūtaṃ abbhañ‍ñāsiṃ jāniṃ paṭivijjhinti aivamatthau vaiditabbau|

aivaṃ sarūpatau sac‍cāni dassaitvā idāni kilaisavasaina pariyāyatau dassaintau ‘‘imai āsavā’’tiādimāha| tassa mai aivaṃ jānatau aivaṃ passatauti tassa mayhaṃ aivaṃ jānantassa aivaṃ passantassa saha vipassanāya kauṭippattaṃ maggaṃ kathaiti| kāmāsavāti kāmāsavatau| vimuc‍citthāti iminā phalakkhaṇaṃ dassaiti| maggakkhaṇai hi cittaṃ vimuc‍cati, phalakkhaṇai vimuttaṃ hauti| vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇanti iminā pac‍cavaikkhaṇañāṇaṃ  dassaiti| khīṇā jātītiādīhi tassa bhūmiṃ| taina hi ñāṇaina bhagavā pac‍cavaikkhantau ‘‘khīṇā jātī’’tiādīni abbhañ‍ñāsiṃ| katamā pana bhagavatau jāti khīṇā, kathañ‍ca naṃ abbhañ‍ñāsīti? vuc‍catai – na tāvassa atītā jāti khīṇā, pubbaiva khīṇattā; na anāgatā, anāgatai vāyāmābhāvatau; na pac‍cuppan‍nā, vij‍jamānattā| yā pana maggassa abhāvitattā uppaj‍jaiyya aikacatupañ‍cavaukārabhavaisu aikacatupañ‍cakkhandhappabhaidā jāti, sā maggassa bhāvitattā anuppādadhammataṃ āpaj‍janaina khīṇā; taṃ sau maggabhāvanāya pahīnakilaisai pac‍cavaikkhitvā ‘‘kilaisābhāvai vij‍jamānampi kammaṃ āyatiṃ appaṭisandhikaṃ hautī’’ti jānantau abbhañ‍ñāsiṃ|

vusitanti vutthaṃ parivutthaṃ, kataṃ caritaṃ niṭṭhitanti atthau| brahmacariyanti maggabrahmacariyaṃ, puthuj‍janakalyāṇakaina hi saddhiṃ satta saikkhā brahmacariyavāsaṃ vasanti nāma, khīṇāsavau vutthavāsau| tasmā bhagavā attanau brahmacariyavāsaṃ pac‍cavaikkhantau ‘‘vusitaṃ brahmacariya’’nti abbhañ‍ñāsiṃ| kataṃ karaṇīyanti catūsu sac‍caisu catūhi maggaihi pariñ‍ñāpahānasacchikiriyābhāvanābhisamayavasaina  sauḷasavidhampi kic‍caṃ niṭṭhāpitanti atthau| puthuj‍janakalyāṇakādayau hi aitaṃ kic‍caṃ karaunti, khīṇāsavau katakaraṇīyau| tasmā bhagavā attanau karaṇīyaṃ pac‍cavaikkhantau ‘‘kataṃ karaṇīya’’nti abbhañ‍ñāsiṃ| nāparaṃ itthattāyāti idāni puna itthabhāvāya aivaṃ sauḷasakic‍cabhāvāya kilaisakkhayāya vā maggabhāvanākic‍caṃ mai natthīti abbhañ‍ñāsiṃ|

idāni aivaṃ pac‍cavaikkhaṇañāṇapariggahitaṃ taṃ āsavānaṃ khayañāṇādhigamaṃ brāhmaṇassa dassaintau ayaṃ khau mai brāhmaṇātiādimāha| tattha vij‍jāti arahattamaggañāṇavij‍jā| avij‍jāti catusac‍capaṭicchādikā avij‍jā| saisaṃ vuttanayamaiva| ayaṃ pana visaisau – ayaṃ khau mai brāhmaṇa tatiyā abhinibbhidā ahausīti aittha ayaṃ khau mama brāhmaṇa āsavānaṃ khayañāṇamukhatuṇḍakaina catusac‍capaṭicchādakaṃ avij‍jaṇḍakausaṃ padālaitvā tatiyā abhinibbhidā tatiyā nikkhanti tatiyā ariyajāti ahausi, kuk‍kuṭacchāpakassaiva mukhatuṇḍakaina vā pādanakhasikhāya vā aṇḍakausaṃ padālaitvā tamhā aṇḍakausamhā abhinibbhidā nikkhanti kuk‍kuṭanikāyai pac‍cājātīti|

aittāvatā  kiṃ dassaitīti? sau hi brāhmaṇa kuk‍kuṭacchāpakau aṇḍakausaṃ

padālaitvā tatau nikkhamantau sakimaiva jāyati, ahaṃ pana pubbai-nivutthakkhandhapaṭicchādakaṃ avij‍jaṇḍakausaṃ bhinditvā paṭhamaṃ tāva pubbainivāsānussatiñāṇavij‍jāya jātau, tatau sattānaṃ cutipaṭisandhipaṭicchādakaṃ avij‍jaṇḍakausaṃ padālaitvā dutiyaṃ dibbacakkhuñāṇavij‍jāya jātau, puna catusac‍capaṭicchādakaṃ avij‍jaṇḍakausaṃ padālaitvā tatiyaṃ āsavānaṃ khayañāṇavij‍jāya jātau; aivaṃ tīhi vij‍jāhi tikkhattuṃ jātau| sā ca mai jāti ariyā suparisuddhāti idaṃ dassaisi| aivaṃ dassaintau ca pubbainivāsañāṇaina atītaṃsañāṇaṃ, dibbacakkhunā pac‍cuppan‍nānāgataṃsañāṇaṃ, āsavakkhayaina sakalalaukiyalaukuttaraguṇanti aivaṃ tīhi vij‍jāhi sabbaipi sabbañ‍ñuguṇai pakāsaitvā attanau ariyāya jātiyā jaiṭṭhasaiṭṭhabhāvaṃ brāhmaṇassa dassaisīti|

āsavakkhayañāṇakathā niṭṭhitā|

daisanānumaudanakathā

15. aivaṃ  vuttai vairañ‍jau brāhmaṇauti aivaṃ bhagavatā laukānukampakaina brāhmaṇaṃ anukampamānaina vinigūhitabbaipi attanau ariyāya jātiyā jaiṭṭhasaiṭṭhabhāvai vij‍jattayapakāsikāya  dhammadaisanāya vuttai pītivipphāraparipuṇṇagattacittau vairañ‍jau brāhmaṇau taṃ bhagavatau ariyāya jātiyā jaiṭṭhasaiṭṭhabhāvaṃ viditvā ‘‘īdisaṃ nāmāhaṃ sabbalaukajaiṭṭhasaiṭṭhaṃ sabbaguṇasaman‍nāgataṃ sabbañ‍ñuṃ ‘añ‍ñaisaṃ abhivādanādikammaṃ na karautī’ti avacaṃ – ‘dhīratthu vatarai añ‍ñāṇa’’’nti attānaṃ garahitvā ‘‘ayaṃ dāni laukai ariyāya jātiyā puraijātaṭṭhaina jaiṭṭhau, sabbaguṇaihi appaṭisamaṭṭhaina saiṭṭhau’’ti niṭṭhaṃ gantvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘jaiṭṭhau bhavaṃ gautamau saiṭṭhau bhavaṃ gautamau’’ti| aivañ‍ca pana vatvā puna taṃ bhagavatau dhammadaisanaṃ abbhanumaudamānau ‘‘abhik‍kantaṃ, bhau gautama, abhik‍kantaṃ, bhau gautamā’’tiādimāha|

tatthāyaṃ abhik‍kantasaddau khayasundarābhirūpaabbhanumaudanaisu dissati| ‘‘abhik‍kantā, bhantai, ratti; nikkhantau paṭhamau yāmau, ciranisin‍nau bhikkhusaṅghau’’tiādīsu  (a॰ ni॰ 8.20) hi khayai dissati| ‘‘ayaṃ mai puggalau khamati, imaisaṃ catun‍naṃ puggalānaṃ abhik‍kantatarau ca paṇītatarau cā’’tiādīsu (a॰ ni॰ 4.100) sundarai|

‘‘kau mai vandati pādāni, iddhiyā yasasā jalaṃ|

abhik‍kantaina vaṇṇaina, sabbā aubhāsayaṃ disā’’ti|| –

ādīsu (vi॰ va॰ 857) abhirūpai| ‘‘abhik‍kantaṃ, bhantai’’tiādīsu (dī॰ ni॰ 1.250) abbhanumaudanai| idhāpi abbhanumaudanaiyaiva| yasmā ca abbhanumaudanai, tasmā ‘‘sādhu sādhu, bhau gautamā’’ti vuttaṃ hautīti vaiditabbaṃ|

‘‘bhayai kaudhai pasaṃsāyaṃ, turitai kautūhalaccharai|

hāsai saukai pasādai ca, karai āmaiḍitaṃ budhau’’ti||

iminā ca lakkhaṇaina idha pasādavasaina pasaṃsāvasaina cāyaṃ dvikkhattuṃ vuttauti vaiditabbau|

atha vā abhik‍kantanti atiiṭṭhaṃ atimanāpaṃ atisundaranti vuttaṃ hauti| tattha aikaina abhik‍kantasaddaina daisanaṃ thaumaiti, aikaina attanau pasādaṃ| ayañhi aittha adhippāyau – ‘‘abhik‍kantaṃ, bhau gautama, yadidaṃ bhautau gautamassa dhammadaisanā, abhik‍kantaṃ yadidaṃ bhautau gautamassa dhammadaisanaṃ āgamma mama pasādau’’ti| bhagavatauyaiva vā vacanaṃ dvai  dvai atthai sandhāya thaumaiti  – bhautau gautamassa vacanaṃ abhik‍kantaṃ dausanāsanatau abhik‍kantaṃ guṇādhigamanatau, tathā saddhājananatau pañ‍ñājananatau, sātthatau sabyañ‍janatau, uttānapadatau gambhīratthatau, kaṇṇasukhatau hadayaṅgamatau, anattuk‍kaṃsanatau aparavambhanatau, karuṇāsītalatau pañ‍ñāvadātatau, apātharamaṇīyatau vimaddakkhamatau, suyyamānasukhatau vīmaṃsiyamānahitatauti aivamādīhi yaujaitabbaṃ|

tatau parampi catūhi upamāhi daisanaṃyaiva thaumaiti| tattha nik‍kuj‍jitanti adhaumukhaṭhapitaṃ, haiṭṭhāmukhajātaṃ vā| uk‍kuj‍jaiyyāti uparimukhaṃ karaiyya| paṭicchan‍nanti tiṇapaṇṇādipaṭicchāditaṃ| vivaraiyyāti ugghāṭaiyya| mūḷhassāti disāmūḷhassa| maggaṃ ācikkhaiyyāti hatthai gahaitvā aisa maggauti  vadaiyya| andhakāraiti kāḷapakkhacātuddasī aḍḍharatta-ghanavanasaṇḍa-maighapaṭalaihi caturaṅgai tamasi| ayaṃ tāva anuttānapadatthau| ayaṃ pana adhippāyayaujanā – yathā kauci nik‍kuj‍jitaṃ uk‍kuj‍jaiyya, aivaṃ saddhammavimukhaṃ asaddhammai patiṭṭhitaṃ maṃ asaddhammā vuṭṭhāpaintaina; yathā paṭicchan‍naṃ vivaraiyya, aivaṃ kassapassa bhagavatau sāsanantaradhānā pabhuti micchādiṭṭhigahanapaṭicchan‍naṃ sāsanaṃ vivarantaina; yathā mūḷhassa maggaṃ ācikkhaiyya, aivaṃ kummaggamicchāmaggappaṭipan‍nassa mai saggamaukkhamaggaṃ ācikkhantaina; yathā andhakārai tailapaj‍jautaṃ dhāraiyya, aivaṃ mauhandhakārai nimuggassa mai buddhādiratanattayarūpāni apassatau tappaṭicchādakamauhandhakāraviddhaṃsakadaisanāpaj‍jautaṃ dhāraintaina, mayhaṃ bhautā gautamaina aitaihi pariyāyaihi pakāsitattā anaikapariyāyaina dhammau pakāsitauti|

daisanānumaudanakathā niṭṭhitā|

pasan‍nākārakathā

aivaṃ daisanaṃ thaumaitvā imāya daisanāya ratanattayai pasan‍nacittau pasan‍nākāraṃ karauntau ‘‘aisāha’’ntiādimāha| tattha aisāhanti aisau ahaṃ| bhavantaṃ gautamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmīti bhavantaṃ gautamaṃ saraṇanti gacchāmi; bhavaṃ mai gautamau saraṇaṃ, parāyaṇaṃ, aghassa tātā, hitassa ca vidhātāti iminā adhippāyaina bhavantaṃ gautamaṃ gacchāmi bhajāmi saivāmi payirupāsāmi, aivaṃ vā jānāmi bujjhāmīti| yaisañhi dhātūnaṃ gatiatthau, buddhipi taisaṃ atthau; tasmā ‘‘gacchāmī’’ti imassa jānāmi bujjhāmīti ayampi atthau vuttau| dhammañ‍ca bhikkhusaṅghañ‍cāti aittha pana adhigatamaggai sacchikataniraudhai yathānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipaj‍jamānai ca catūsu apāyaisu apatamānai  dhāraitīti dhammau; sau atthatau ariyamaggau caiva nibbānañ‍ca| vuttaṃ haitaṃ – ‘‘yāvatā, bhikkhavai, dhammā saṅkhatā, ariyau aṭṭhaṅgikau maggau taisaṃ aggamakkhāyatī’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 4.34) vitthārau| na kaivalañ‍ca ariyamaggau caiva nibbānañ‍ca, api ca khau ariyaphalaihi saddhiṃ pariyattidhammaupi| vuttampi haitaṃ chattamāṇavakavimānai –

‘‘rāgavirāgamanaijamasaukaṃ, dhammamasaṅkhatamappaṭikūlaṃ|

madhuramimaṃ paguṇaṃ suvibhattaṃ, dhammamimaṃ saraṇatthamupaihī’’ti|| (vi॰ va॰ 887)|

aittha hi rāgavirāgauti maggau kathitau| anaijamasaukanti phalaṃ| dhammamasaṅkhatanti nibbānaṃ| appaṭikūlaṃ madhuramimaṃ paguṇaṃ suvibhattanti piṭakattayaina vibhattā  sabbadhammakkhandhāti| diṭṭhisīlasaṅghātaina saṃhatauti saṅghau, sau atthatau aṭṭhaariyapuggalasamūhau| vuttañhaitaṃ tasmiṃyaiva vimānai –

‘‘yattha ca din‍namahapphalamāhu, catūsu sucīsu purisayugaisu|

aṭṭha ca puggaladhammadasā tai, saṅghamimaṃ saraṇatthamupaihī’’ti|| (vi॰ va॰ 888)|

bhikkhūnaṃ saṅghau bhikkhusaṅghau| aittāvatā ca brāhmaṇau tīṇi saraṇagamanāni paṭivaidaisi|

pasan‍nākārakathā niṭṭhitā|

saraṇagamanakathā

idāni taisvaiva tīsu saraṇagamanaisu kausal‍latthaṃ saraṇaṃ, saraṇagamanaṃ, yau saraṇaṃ gacchati,

saraṇagamanappabhaidau, saraṇagamanaphalaṃ, saṃkilaisau, bhaidauti ayaṃ vidhi vaidi tabbau| sau pana idha vuc‍camānau atibhāriyaṃ vinayanidānaṃ karautīti na vuttau| atthikaihi pana papañ‍casūdaniyaṃ vā majjhimaṭṭhakathāyaṃ bhayabhairavasuttavaṇṇanatau (ma॰ ni॰ aṭṭha॰ 1.56) sumaṅgalavilāsiniyaṃ vā dīghanikāyaṭṭhakathāyaṃ (dī॰ ni॰ aṭṭha॰ 1.250) saraṇavaṇṇanatau gahaitabbauti|

saraṇagamanakathā niṭṭhitā|

upāsakattapaṭivaidanākathā

upāsakaṃ  maṃ bhavaṃ gautamau dhāraitūti maṃ bhavaṃ gautamau ‘‘upāsakau aya’’nti aivaṃ dhāraitūti atthau| upāsakavidhikausal‍latthaṃ panaittha kau upāsakau, kasmā  upāsakauti vuc‍cati, kimassa sīlaṃ, kau ājīvau, kā vipatti, kā sampattīti idaṃ pakiṇṇakaṃ vaiditabbaṃ| taṃ atibhāriyakaraṇatau idha na vibhattaṃ, atthikaihi pana papañ‍casūdaniyaṃ majjhimaṭṭhakathāyaṃ (ma॰ ni॰ aṭṭha॰ 1.56) vuttanayainaiva vaiditabbaṃ| aj‍jataggaiti aittha ayaṃ aggasaddau ādikauṭikauṭṭhāsasaiṭṭhaisu dissati| ‘‘aj‍jataggai, samma dauvārika, āvarāmi dvāraṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ nigaṇṭhīna’’ntiādīsu (ma॰ ni॰ 2.70) hi ādimhi dissati| ‘‘tainaiva aṅgulaggaina taṃ aṅgulaggaṃ parāmasaiyya (kathā॰ 441), ucchaggaṃ vaiḷagga’’ntiādīsu kauṭiyaṃ| ‘‘ambilaggaṃ vā madhuraggaṃ vā tittakaggaṃ vā (saṃ॰ ni॰ 5.374) anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, vihāraggaina vā parivaiṇaggaina vā bhājaitu’’ntiādīsu (cūḷava॰ 318) kauṭṭhāsai| ‘‘yāvatā, bhikkhavai, sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā…pai॰… tathāgatau taisaṃ aggamakkhāyatī’’tiādīsu (a॰ ni॰ 4.34) saiṭṭhai| idha panāyaṃ ādimhi daṭṭhabbau| tasmā aj‍jataggaiti aj‍jataṃ ādiṃ katvāti aivamaittha atthau vaiditabbau| aj‍jatanti aj‍jabhāvanti vuttaṃ hauti| aj‍jadaggai ic‍caiva vā  pāṭhau, dakārau padasandhikarau, aj‍ja aggaṃ katvāti vuttaṃ hauti| pāṇupaitanti pāṇaihi upaitaṃ, yāva mai jīvitaṃ pavattati, tāva upaitaṃ anañ‍ñasatthukaṃ tīhi saraṇagamanaihi saraṇagataṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gautamau dhāraitu jānātu, ahañhi sacaipi mai tikhiṇaina asinā sīsaṃ chindaiyyuṃ, naiva buddhaṃ ‘‘na buddhau’’ti vā, dhammaṃ ‘‘na dhammau’’ti vā, saṅghaṃ ‘‘na saṅghau’’ti vā vadaiyyanti| aittha ca brāhmaṇau pāṇupaitaṃ saraṇagatanti puna saraṇagamanaṃ vadantau attasan‍niyyātanaṃ pakāsaitīti vaiditabbau|

aivaṃ attānaṃ niyyātaitvā bhagavantaṃ saparisaṃ upaṭṭhātukāmau āha – ‘‘adhivāsaitu ca mai bhavaṃ gautamau vairañ‍jāyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghainā’’ti| kiṃ vuttaṃ hauti – upāsakañ‍ca maṃ bhavaṃ gautamau dhāraitu, adhivāsaitu ca mai vairañ‍jāyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ, tayau māsai vairañ‍jaṃ upanissāya mama anuggahatthaṃ vāsaṃ sampaṭicchatūti| adhivāsaisi bhagavā tuṇhībhāvaināti athassa vacanaṃ sutvā bhagavā kāyaṅgaṃ vā vācaṅgaṃ vā acaupaitvā abbhantaraiyaiva khantiṃ cāraitvā tuṇhībhāvaina adhivāsaisi; brāhmaṇassa anuggahatthaṃ manasāva sampaṭicchīti  vuttaṃ hauti|

atha khau vairañ‍jau brāhmaṇau bhagavatau adhivāsanaṃ viditvāti atha vairañ‍jau brāhmaṇau sacai mai  samaṇau gautamau nādhivāsaiyya, kāyaina vā vācāya vā paṭikkhipaiyya| yasmā pana appaṭikkhipitvā abbhantarai khantiṃ dhāraisi, tasmā mai manasāva adhivāsaisīti aivaṃ ākārasal‍lakkhaṇakusalatāya bhagavatau adhivāsanaṃ viditvā, attanau nisin‍nāsanatau vuṭṭhāya catūsu disāsu bhagavantaṃ sak‍kac‍caṃ vanditvā tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā āgatakālatau pabhuti jātimahal‍lakabrāhmaṇānaṃ abhivādanādīni na karautīti vigarahitvāpi idāni viñ‍ñātabuddhaguṇau kāyaina vācāya manasā ca anaikakkhattuṃ vandantaupi atittauyaiva hutvā dasanakhasamaudhānasamuj‍jalaṃ añ‍jaliṃ paggayha sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhāpaitvā yāva dassanavisayau tāva paṭimukhauyaiva apak‍kamitvā dassanavisayaṃ vijahanaṭṭhānai vanditvā pak‍kāmi|

upāsakattapaṭivaidanākathā niṭṭhitā|

dubbhikkhakathā

16. taina khau pana samayaina vairañ‍jā dubbhikkhā hautīti yasmiṃ samayai vairañ‍jaina brāhmaṇaina bhagavā vairañ‍jaṃ upanissāya vassāvāsaṃ yācitau, taina samayaina vairañ‍jā dubbhikkhā hauti| dubbhikkhāti dul‍labhabhikkhā; sā pana dul‍labhabhikkhatā yattha manussā assaddhā haunti appasan‍nā, tattha susassakālaipi atisamagghaipi pubbaṇṇāparaṇṇai hauti| vairañ‍jāyaṃ pana yasmā na tathā ahausi, apica khau dusassatāya chātakadausaina ahausi tasmā tamatthaṃ dassaintau dvīhitikātiādimāha| tattha dvīhitikāti dvidhā pavattaīhitikā| īhitaṃ nāma iriyā dvidhā pavattā – cittairiyā, cittaīhā| ‘‘aittha lacchāma nu khau kiñ‍ci bhikkhamānā na lacchāmā’’ti, ‘‘jīvituṃ vā sakkhissāma nu khau nau’’ti ayamaittha adhippāyau|

atha vā dvīhitikāti duj‍jīvikā, īhitaṃ īhā iriyanaṃ pavattanaṃ jīvitantiādīni padāni aikatthāni| tasmā dukkhaina īhitaṃ aittha pavattatīti dvīhitikāti ayamaittha  padatthau| saitaṭṭhikāti saitakāni aṭṭhīni aitthāti saitaṭṭhikā| divasampi yācitvā kiñ‍ci aladdhā matānaṃ kapaṇamanussānaṃ ahicchattakavaṇṇaihi aṭṭhīhi tatra tatra parikiṇṇāti vuttaṃ hauti| saitaṭṭikātipi pāṭhau| tassatthau – saitā aṭṭi aitthāti saitaṭṭikā| aṭṭīti āturatā byādhi raugau| tattha ca sassānaṃ gabbhaggahaṇakālai saitakaraugaina upahatamaiva pacchin‍nakhīraṃ aggahitataṇḍulaṃ paṇḍarapaṇḍaraṃ sālisīsaṃ vā yavagaudhūmasīsaṃ vā nikkhamati, tasmā ‘‘saitaṭṭikā’’ti vuc‍cati|

vappakālai  suṭṭhu abhisaṅkharitvāpi vuttasassaṃ tattha salākā aiva sampaj‍jatīti salākāvuttā; salākāya vā tattha jīvitaṃ pavattaintīti salākāvuttā| kiṃ vuttaṃ hauti? tattha kira dhañ‍ñavik‍kayakānaṃ santikaṃ kayakaisu gataisu dubbalamanussai abhibhavitvā balavamanussāva dhañ‍ñaṃ kiṇitvā gacchanti| dubbalamanussā alabhamānā mahāsaddaṃ karaunti| dhañ‍ñavik‍kayakā ‘‘sabbaisaṃ saṅgahaṃ karissāmā’’ti dhañ‍ñakaraṇaṭṭhānai dhañ‍ñamāpakaṃ nisīdāpaitvā aikapassai vaṇṇajjhakkhaṃ nisīdāpaisuṃ| dhañ‍ñatthikā vaṇṇajjhakkhassa santikaṃ gacchanti| sau āgatapaṭipāṭiyā mūlaṃ gahaitvā ‘‘itthan‍nāmassa aittakaṃ dātabba’’nti salākaṃ likhitvā daiti, tai taṃ gahaitvā dhañ‍ñamāpakassa santikaṃ gantvā din‍napaṭipāṭiyā dhañ‍ñaṃ gaṇhanti| aivaṃ salākāya tattha jīvitaṃ pavattaintīti salākāvuttā|

na  sukarā uñchaina paggahaina yāpaitunti paggahaina yau uñchau, taina yāpaituṃ na sukarā| pattaṃ gahaitvā yaṃ ariyā uñchaṃ karaunti, bhikkhācariyaṃ caranti, taina uñchaina yāpaituṃ na sukarāti vuttaṃ hauti| tadā kira tattha sattaṭṭhagāmai piṇḍāya caritvā aikadivasampi yāpanamattaṃ na labhanti|

taina khau pana samayaina uttarāpathakā assavāṇijā…pai॰… assausi khau bhagavā udukkhalasaddanti – taināti yasmiṃ samayai bhagavā vairañ‍jaṃ upanissāya vassāvāsaṃ upagatau taina samayaina| uttarāpathavāsikā uttarāpathatau vā āgatattā aivaṃ laddhavauhārā assavāṇijā uttarāpathai assānaṃ uṭṭhānaṭṭhānai  pañ‍ca assasatāni gahaitvā diguṇaṃ tiguṇaṃ lābhaṃ patthayamānā daisantaraṃ gacchantā taihi attanau vik‍kāyikabhaṇḍabhūtaihi pañ‍camattaihi assasataihi vairañ‍jaṃ vassāvāsaṃ upagatā haunti| kasmā? na hi sak‍kā tasmiṃ daisai vassikai cattārau māsai addhānaṃ paṭipaj‍jituṃ| upagacchantā ca bahinagarai udakaina anajjhauttharaṇīyai ṭhānai attanau ca vāsāgārāni assānañ‍ca mandiraṃ kārāpaitvā vatiyā parikkhipiṃsu| tāni taisaṃ vasanaṭṭhānāni ‘‘assamaṇḍalikāyau’’ti pañ‍ñāyiṃsu| taināha – ‘‘taihi assamaṇḍalikāsu bhikkhūnaṃ patthapatthapulakaṃ pañ‍ñattaṃ hautī’’ti| patthapatthapulakanti aikamaikassa bhikkhunau patthapatthapamāṇaṃ pulakaṃ| patthau nāma nāḷimattaṃ hauti, aikassa purisassa alaṃ yāpanāya| vuttampi haitaṃ – ‘‘patthaudanau nālamayaṃ duvin‍na’’nti (jā॰ 2.21.192)| pulakaṃ nāma nitthusaṃ katvā ussaidaitvā gahitayavataṇḍulā vuc‍canti| yadi hi sathusā haunti, pāṇakā vijjhanti, addhānakkhamā na haunti| tasmā tai vāṇijā addhānakkhamaṃ katvā yavataṇḍulamādāya addhānaṃ paṭipaj‍janti  ‘‘yattha assānaṃ khādanīyaṃ tiṇaṃ dul‍labhaṃ bhavissati, tatthaitaṃ assabhattaṃ bhavissatī’’ti|

kasmā pana taihi taṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pañ‍ñattanti? vuc‍catai – ‘‘na hi tai dakkhiṇāpathamanussā viya assaddhā appasan‍nā, tai pana saddhā pasan‍nā buddhamāmakā, dhammamāmakā, saṅghamāmakā; tai pubbaṇhasamayaṃ kainacidaiva karaṇīyaina nagaraṃ pavisantā dvai tayau divasai addasaṃsu sattaṭṭha bhikkhū sunivatthai supārutai  iriyāpathasampan‍nai sakalampi nagaraṃ piṇḍāya caritvā kiñ‍ci alabhamānai| disvāna naisaṃ aitadahausi – ‘‘ayyā imaṃ nagaraṃ upanissāya vassaṃ upagatā; chātakañ‍ca vattati, na ca kiñ‍ci labhanti, ativiya kilamanti| mayañ‍camha āgantukā, na sak‍kauma naisaṃ daivasikaṃ yāguñ‍ca bhattañ‍ca paṭiyādaituṃ| amhākaṃ pana assā sāyañ‍ca pātau ca dvikkhattuṃ bhattaṃ labhanti| yaṃnūna mayaṃ aikamaikassa assassa pātarāsabhattatau aikamaikassa bhikkhunau patthapatthapulakaṃ dadaiyyāma| aivaṃ ayyā ca na kilamissanti, assā ca yāpaissantī’’ti| tai bhikkhūnaṃ santikaṃ gantvā aitamatthaṃ āraucaitvā ‘‘bhantai, tumhai patthapatthapulakaṃ paṭiggahaitvā yaṃ vā taṃ vā katvā paribhuñ‍jathā’’ti yācitvā daivasikaṃ patthapatthapulakaṃ pañ‍ñapaisuṃ| taina vuttaṃ – ‘‘taihi assamaṇḍalikāsu bhikkhūnaṃ patthapatthapulakaṃ pañ‍ñattaṃ hautī’’ti|

pañ‍ñattanti nic‍cabhattasaṅkhaipaina ṭhapitaṃ| idāni bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsaitvātiādīsu pubbaṇhasamayanti divasassa pubbabhāgasamayaṃ, pubbaṇhasamayaiti atthau| pubbaṇhai vā samayaṃ pubbaṇhasamayaṃ, pubbaṇhai aikaṃ khaṇanti vuttaṃ hauti| aivaṃ ac‍cantasaṃyaugai upayaugavacanaṃ labbhati| nivāsaitvāti paridahitvā, vihāranivāsanaparivattanavasainaitaṃ vaiditabbaṃ| na hi tai tatau pubbai anivatthā ahaisuṃ| pattacīvaramādāyāti pattaṃ hatthaihi cīvaraṃ kāyaina ādiyitvā sampaṭicchādaitvā, dhāraitvāti atthau| yaina vā taina vā hi pakāraina gaṇhantā ādāyaic‍caiva vuc‍canti, yathā ‘‘samādāyaiva pak‍kamatī’’ti (dī॰ ni॰ 1.21)| piṇḍaṃ alabhamānāti sakalampi vairañ‍jaṃ caritvā tiṭṭhatu piṇḍau, antamasau ‘‘aticchathā’’ti vācampi alabhamānā|

patthapatthapulakaṃ ārāmaṃ āharitvāti gatagataṭṭhānai laddhaṃ aikamaikaṃ patthapatthapulakaṃ gahaitvā ārāmaṃ naitvā| udukkhalai kauṭṭaitvā kauṭṭaitvā paribhuñ‍jantīti thairānaṃ kauci kappiyakārakau natthi, yau naisaṃ taṃ gahaitvā yāguṃ vā bhattaṃ vā pacaiyya| sāmampi pacanaṃ samaṇasāruppaṃ na hauti na ca vaṭṭati| tai aivaṃ nau sal‍lahukavuttitā ca bhavissati, sāmapākaparimaucanañ‍cāti aṭṭha aṭṭha  janā vā dasa dasa janā vā aikatau hutvā udukkhalai kauṭṭaitvā kauṭṭaitvā sakaṃ sakaṃ paṭivīsaṃ udakaina taimaitvā paribhuñ‍janti| aivaṃ paribhuñ‍jitvā appaussuk‍kā samaṇadhammaṃ karaunti| bhagavatau pana tai assavāṇijā patthapulakañ‍ca dainti, tadupiyañ‍ca sappimadhusak‍karaṃ| taṃ āyasmā ānandau āharitvā silāyaṃ pisati| puñ‍ñavatā paṇḍitapurisaina kataṃ manāpamaiva hauti| atha naṃ pisitvā sappiādīhi sammā yaujaitvā bhagavatau  upanāmaisi| athaittha daivatā dibbaujaṃ pakkhipanti| taṃ bhagavā paribhuñ‍jati| paribhuñ‍jitvā phalasamāpattiyā kālaṃ atināmaiti| na tatau paṭṭhāya piṇḍāya carati|

kiṃ panānandatthairau tadā bhagavatau upaṭṭhākau hautīti? hauti, nau ca khau upaṭṭhākaṭṭhānaṃ laddhā| bhagavatau hi paṭhamabaudhiyaṃ vīsativassantarai nibaddhupaṭṭhākau nāma natthi| kadāci nāgasamālatthairau bhagavantaṃ upaṭṭhāsi, kadāci nāgitatthairau, kadāci maighiyatthairau, kadāci upavāṇatthairau, kadāci sāgatatthairau, kadāci sunakkhattau licchaviputtau| tai attanau ruciyā upaṭṭhahitvā yadā icchanti tadā pak‍kamanti| ānandatthairau taisu taisu upaṭṭhahantaisu appaussuk‍kau hauti, pak‍kantaisu sayamaiva vattapaṭipattiṃ karauti| bhagavāpi kiñ‍cāpi mai ñātisaiṭṭhau upaṭṭhākaṭṭhānaṃ na tāva labhati, atha khau aivarūpaisu ṭhānaisu ayamaiva patirūpauti adhivāsaisi| taina vuttaṃ – ‘‘āyasmā panānandau patthapulakaṃ silāyaṃ pisitvā bhagavatau upanāmaisi, taṃ bhagavā paribhuñ‍jatī’’ti|

nanu ca manussā dubbhikkhakālai ativiya ussāhajātā puñ‍ñāni karaunti, attanā abhuñ‍jitvāpi bhikkhūnaṃ dātabbaṃ mañ‍ñanti| tai tadā kasmā kaṭacchubhikkhampi na adaṃsu? ayañ‍ca vairañ‍jau brāhmaṇau mahatā ussāhaina bhagavantaṃ vassāvāsaṃ yāci, sau kasmā bhagavatau atthibhāvampi na jānātīti? vuc‍catai – mārāvaṭṭanāya| vairañ‍jañhi brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavatau santikā pak‍kantamattamaiva sakalañ‍ca nagaraṃ samantā ca yaujanamattaṃ yattha sak‍kā puraibhattaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pac‍cāgantuṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ mārau āvaṭṭaitvā mauhaitvā sabbaisaṃ asal‍lakkhaṇabhāvaṃ katvā pak‍kāmi| tasmā na kauci antamasau sāmīcikammampi kattabbaṃ mañ‍ñittha|

kiṃ  pana bhagavāpi mārāvaṭṭanaṃ ajānitvāva tattha vassaṃ upagatauti? nau ajānitvā| atha kasmā campā-sāvatthi-rājagahādīnaṃ añ‍ñatarasmiṃ na upagatauti? tiṭṭhantu campā-sāvatthi-rājagahādīni, sacaipi bhagavā tasmiṃ saṃvaccharai  uttarakuruṃ vā tidasapuraṃ vā gantvā vassaṃ upagacchaiyya, tampi mārau āvaṭṭaiyya| sau kira taṃ saṃvaccharaṃ ativiya āghātaina  pariyuṭṭhitacittau ahausi| idha pana bhagavā imaṃ atiraikakāraṇaṃ addasa – ‘‘assavāṇijā bhikkhūnaṃ saṅgahaṃ karissantī’’ti| tasmā vairañ‍jāyamaiva vassaṃ upagacchi|

kiṃ pana mārau vāṇijakai āvaṭṭaituṃ na sak‍kautīti? nau na sak‍kauti, tai pana āvaṭṭitapariyausānai āgamiṃsu| paṭinivattitvā kasmā na āvaṭṭaitīti? avisahatāya| na hi sau tathāgatassa abhihaṭabhikkhāya nibaddhadānassa appitavattassa antarāyaṃ kātuṃ visahati| catun‍nañhi na sak‍kā antarāyau kātuṃ| katamaisaṃ catun‍naṃ? tathāgatassa abhihaṭabhikkhāsaṅkhaipaina vā nibaddhadānassa appitavattasaṅkhaipaina vā paric‍cattānaṃ catun‍naṃ pac‍cayānaṃ na sak‍kā kainaci antarāyau kātuṃ| buddhānaṃ jīvitassa na sak‍kā kainaci antarāyau kātuṃ| asītiyā anubyañ‍janānaṃ byāmappabhāya vā na sak‍kā kainaci antarāyau kātuṃ| candimasūriyadaivabrahmānampi hi pabhā tathāgatassa anubyañ‍janabyāmappabhāppadaisaṃ patvā vihatānubhāvā haunti| buddhānaṃ sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇassa na sak‍kā kainaci antarāyau kātunti imaisaṃ catun‍naṃ na sak‍kā kainaci antarāyau kātuṃ| tasmā māraina akatantarāyaṃ bhikkhaṃ bhagavā sasāvakasaṅghau tadā paribhuñ‍jatīti vaiditabbau|

aivaṃ paribhuñ‍jantau ca aikadivasaṃ assausi khau bhagavā udukkhalasaddanti bhagavā patthapatthapulakaṃ kauṭṭaintānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ musalasaṅghaṭṭajanitaṃ udukkhalasaddaṃ suṇi| tatau paraṃ jānantāpi tathāgatāti aivamādi yaṃ paratau ‘‘kin‍nu khau sau, ānanda, udukkhalasaddau’’ti pucchi, tassa parihāradassanatthaṃ vuttaṃ| tatrāyaṃ saṅkhaipavaṇṇanā – tathāgatā nāma jānantāpi sacai tādisaṃ pucchākāraṇaṃ hauti, pucchanti| sacai pana tādisaṃ pucchākāraṇaṃ natthi, jānantāpi  na pucchanti| yasmā pana buddhānaṃ ajānanaṃ nāma natthi, tasmā ajānantāpīti na vuttaṃ| kālaṃ viditvā pucchantīti sacai tassā pucchāya sau kālau hauti, aivaṃ taṃ kālaṃ viditvā pucchanti; sacai na hauti, aivampi kālaṃ viditvāva na pucchanti| aivaṃ pucchantāpi ca atthasaṃhitaṃ tathāgatā pucchanti, yaṃ atthanissitaṃ kāraṇanissitaṃ, tadaiva pucchanti, nau anatthasaṃhitaṃ| kasmā? yasmā anatthasaṃhitai saitughātau tathāgatānaṃ| saitu vuc‍cati maggau, maggainaiva tādisassa vacanassa ghātau, samucchaidauti vuttaṃ hauti|

idāni atthasaṃhitanti aittha yaṃ atthasan‍nissitaṃ vacanaṃ tathāgatā pucchanti, taṃ dassaintau ‘‘dvīhākāraihī’’ti ādimāha| tattha ākāraihīti kāraṇaihi| dhammaṃ vā daisaissāmāti aṭṭhuppattiyuttaṃ suttaṃ vā pubbacaritakāraṇayuttaṃ jātakaṃ vā kathayissāma| sāvakānaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ  pañ‍ñapaissāmāti sāvakānaṃ vā tāya pucchāya vītik‍kamaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā garukaṃ vā lahukaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaissāma āṇaṃ ṭhapaissāmāti|

atha khau bhagavā…pai॰… aitamatthaṃ āraucaisīti aittha natthi kiñ‍ci vattabbaṃ| pubbai vuttamaiva hi bhikkhūnaṃ patthapatthapulakapaṭilābhaṃ sal‍lahukavuttitaṃ sāmapākaparimaucanañ‍ca āraucaintau aitamatthaṃ āraucaisīti vuc‍cati| ‘‘sādhu sādhu, ānandā’’ti idaṃ pana bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ sampahaṃsaintau āha| sādhukāraṃ pana datvā dvīsu ākāraisu aikaṃ gahaitvā dhammaṃ daisaintau āha – ‘‘tumhaihi, ānanda, sappurisaihi vijitaṃ, pacchimā janatā sālimaṃsaudanaṃ atimañ‍ñissatī’’ti| tatrāyamadhippāyau – tumhaihi, ānanda, sappurisaihi aivaṃ dubbhikkhai dul‍labhapiṇḍai imāya sal‍lahukavuttitāya iminā ca sal‍laikhaina vijitaṃ| kiṃ vijitanti? dubbhikkhaṃ vijitaṃ, laubhau vijitau, icchācārau vijitau| kathaṃ? ‘‘ayaṃ vairañ‍jā dubbhikkhā, samantatau pana anantarā gāmanigamā phalabhāranamitasassā subhikkhā sulabhapiṇḍā| aivaṃ santaipi bhagavā idhaiva amhai niggaṇhitvā vasatī’’ti aikabhikkhussapi cintā vā vighātau vā natthi| aivaṃ tāva dubbhikkhaṃ vijitaṃ abhibhūtaṃ attanau vasai vattitaṃ|

kathaṃ laubhau vijitau? ‘‘ayaṃ vairañ‍jā dubbhikkhā, samantatau pana anantarā gāmanigamā phalabhāranamitasassā subhikkhā sulabhapiṇḍā| handa mayaṃ tattha gantvā paribhuñ‍jissāmā’’ti laubhavasaina aikabhikkhunāpi ratticchaidau vā ‘‘pacchimikāya tattha vassaṃ upagacchāmā’’ti vassacchaidau vā na katau| aivaṃ laubhau vijitau|

kathaṃ  icchācārau vijitau? ayaṃ vairañ‍jā dubbhikkhā, imai ca manussā amhai dvai tayau māsai vasantaipi na kismiñ‍ci mañ‍ñanti| yaṃnūna mayaṃ guṇavāṇij‍jaṃ katvā ‘‘asukau bhikkhu paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhī…pai॰… asukau chaḷabhiñ‍ñauti aivaṃ manussānaṃ añ‍ñamañ‍ñaṃ pakāsaitvā kucchiṃ paṭijaggitvā pacchā sīlaṃ adhiṭṭhahaiyyāmā’’ti aikabhikkhunāpi aivarūpā icchā na uppāditā| aivaṃ icchācārau vijitau abhibhūtau attanau vasai vattitauti|

anāgatai pana pacchimā janatā vihārai nisin‍nā appakasirainaiva labhitvāpi ‘‘kiṃ idaṃ uttaṇḍulaṃ atikilin‍naṃ alauṇaṃ atilauṇaṃ anambilaṃ ac‍cambilaṃ, kau iminā atthau’’ti ādinā nayaina sālimaṃsaudanaṃ atimañ‍ñissati, auñ‍ñātaṃ avañ‍ñātaṃ karissati| atha vā janapadau  nāma na sabbakālaṃ dubbhikkhau hauti| aikadā dubbhikkhau hauti, aikadā subhikkhau hauti| svāyaṃ yadā subhikkhau bhavissati, tadā tumhākaṃ sappurisānaṃ imāya paṭipattiyā pasan‍nā manussā bhikkhūnaṃ yāgukhaj‍jakādippabhaidaina anaikappakāraṃ sālivikatiṃ maṃsaudanañ‍ca dātabbaṃ mañ‍ñissanti| taṃ tumhai nissāya uppan‍naṃ sak‍kāraṃ tumhākaṃ sabrahmacārīsaṅkhātā pacchimā janatā tumhākaṃ antarai nisīditvā anubhavamānāva atimañ‍ñissati, tappac‍cayaṃ mānañ‍ca aumānañ‍ca karissati| kathaṃ? kasmā aittakaṃ pak‍kaṃ, kiṃ tumhākaṃ bhājanāni natthi, yattha attanau santakaṃ pakkhipitvā ṭhapaiyyāthāti|

dubbhikkhakathā niṭṭhitā|

mahāmauggal‍lānassasīhanādakathā

17. atha khau āyasmā mahāmauggal‍lānautiādīsu āyasmāti piyavacanamaitaṃ, garugāravasappatissādhivacanamaitaṃ| mahāmauggal‍lānauti mahā ca sau guṇamahantatāya mauggal‍lānau ca gauttaināti mahāmauggal‍lānau| aitadavaucāti aitaṃ avauca| idāni vattabbaṃ ‘‘aitarahi bhantai’’tiādivacanaṃ dassaiti| kasmā avauca? thairau kira pabbajitvā sattamai divasai sāvakapāramiñāṇassa  matthakaṃ pattau, satthārāpi mahiddhikatāya aitadaggai ṭhapitau| sau taṃ attanau mahiddhikataṃ nissāya cintaisi – ‘‘ayaṃ vairañ‍jā dubbhikkhā, bhikkhū ca kilamanti, yaṃnūnāhaṃ pathaviṃ parivattaitvā bhikkhū pappaṭakaujaṃ bhaujaiyya’’nti| athassa  aitadahausi – ‘‘sacai panāhaṃ bhagavatau santikai viharantau bhagavantaṃ ayācitvā aivaṃ karaiyyaṃ, na maitaṃ assa patirūpaṃ; yugaggāhau viya bhagavatā saddhiṃ katau bhavaiyyā’’ti| tasmā yācitukāmau āgantvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca|

haiṭṭhimatalaṃ sampan‍nanti pathaviyā kira haiṭṭhimatalai pathavimaṇḍau pathavaujau pathavi-pappaṭakau atthi, taṃ sandhāya vadati| tattha sampan‍nanti madhuraṃ, sādurasanti atthau| yathaiva hi ‘‘tatrassa rukkhau sampan‍naphalau ca upapan‍naphalau cā’’ti (ma॰ ni॰ 2.48) aittha madhuraphalauti atthau; aivamidhāpi sampan‍nanti madhuraṃ sādurasanti vaiditabbaṃ| saiyyathāpi khuddamadhuṃ anīḷakanti idaṃ panassa madhuratāya aupammanidassanatthaṃ vuttaṃ| khuddamadhunti khuddakamakkhikāhi katamadhu| anīḷakanti nimmakkhikaṃ nimmakkhikaṇḍakaṃ parisuddhaṃ| aitaṃ kira madhu sabbamadhūhi aggañ‍ca saiṭṭhañ‍ca surasañ‍ca aujavantañ‍ca| taināha – ‘‘saiyyathāpi khuddamadhuṃ anīḷakaṃ aivamassāda’’nti|

sādhāhaṃ, bhantaiti sādhu ahaṃ, bhantai| aittha sādhūti āyācanavacanamaitaṃ| pathaviparivattanaṃ āyācantau hi thairau bhagavantaṃ aivamāha| parivattaiyyanti uk‍kuj‍jaiyyaṃ, haiṭṭhimatalaṃ uparimaṃ karaiyyaṃ| kasmā? aivañhi katai sukhaina bhikkhū pappaṭakaujaṃ pathavimaṇḍaṃ paribhuñ‍jissantīti| atha bhagavā ananuñ‍ñātukāmaupi thairaṃ sīhanādaṃ nadāpaituṃ pucchi – ‘‘yai pana tai, mauggal‍lāna, pathavinissitā pāṇā tai kathaṃ karissasī’’ti| yai pathavinissitā gāmanigamādīsu pāṇā, tai pathaviyā parivattiyamānāya ākāsai  saṇṭhātuṃ asak‍kauntai kathaṃ karissasi, kattha ṭhapaissasīti? atha thairau bhagavatā aitadaggai ṭhapitabhāvānurūpaṃ attanau iddhānubhāvaṃ pakāsaintau ‘‘aikāhaṃ, bhantai’’tiādimāha| tassatthau – aikaṃ ahaṃ bhantai hatthaṃ yathā ayaṃ mahāpathavī aivaṃ abhinimminissāmi, pathavisadisaṃ karissāmi| aivaṃ katvā yai pathavinissitā pāṇā tai aikasmiṃ hatthatalai ṭhitai pāṇai tatau dutiyahatthatalai saṅkāmaintau viya tattha saṅkāmaissāmīti|

athassa bhagavā āyācanaṃ paṭikkhipantau ‘‘alaṃ mauggal‍lānā’’tiādimāha| tattha alanti paṭikkhaipavacanaṃ| vipal‍lāsampi sattā paṭilabhaiyyunti viparītaggāhampi sattā sampāpuṇaiyyuṃ| kathaṃ? ayaṃ nu khau pathavī, udāhu na ayanti| atha vā amhākaṃ nu khau ayaṃ gāmau, udāhu añ‍ñaisa’’nti| aivaṃ nigamajanapadakhaittārāmādīsu| na vā aisa vipal‍lāsau, acintaiyyau hi iddhimatau iddhivisayau| aivaṃ pana vipal‍lāsaṃ paṭilabhaiyyuṃ – idaṃ dubbhikkhaṃ nāma na idāniyaiva hauti, anāgataipi bhavissati| tadā bhikkhū tādisaṃ iddhimantaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ kutau labhissanti? tai sautāpan‍na-sakadāgāmi-anāgāmi-sukkhavipassaka-jhānalābhi-paṭisambhidāppattakhīṇāsavāpi samānā iddhibalābhāvā parakulāni piṇḍāya upasaṅkamissanti| tatra manussānaṃ aivaṃ bhavissati – ‘‘buddhakālai bhikkhū sikkhāsu paripūrakārinau ahaisuṃ| tai guṇai nibbattaitvā dubbhikkhakālai pathaviṃ parivattaitvā pappaṭakaujaṃ paribhuñ‍jiṃsu| idāni pana sikkhāya paripūrakārinau natthi| yadi siyuṃ, tathaiva karaiyyuṃ| na amhākaṃ yaṃ kiñ‍ci pak‍kaṃ vā āmaṃ vā khādituṃ dadaiyyu’’nti| aivaṃ taisuyaiva ariyapuggalaisu ‘‘natthi ariyapuggalā’’ti imaṃ vipal‍lāsaṃ paṭilabhaiyyuṃ| vipal‍lāsavasaina ca ariyai garahantā upavadantā apāyupagā bhavaiyyuṃ| tasmā mā tai ruc‍ci pathaviṃ parivattaitunti|

atha thairau imaṃ yācanaṃ alabhamānau añ‍ñaṃ yācantau ‘‘sādhu, bhantai’’tiādimāha| tampissa bhagavā paṭikkhipantau ‘‘alaṃ  mauggal‍lānā’’tiādimāha| tattha kiñ‍cāpi na vuttaṃ ‘‘vipal‍lāsampi sattā paṭilabhaiyyu’’nti, atha khau pubbai vuttanayainaiva gahaitabbaṃ; atthaupi cassa vuttasadisamaiva vaiditabbau| yadi pana bhagavā anujānaiyya, thairau kiṃ karaiyyāti? mahāsamuddaṃ aikaina  padavītihāraina atik‍kamitabbaṃ mātikāmattaṃ adhiṭṭhahitvā naḷairupucimandatau uttarakuruabhimukhaṃ maggaṃ nīharitvā uttarakuruṃ gamanāgamanasampan‍nai ṭhānai katvā dassaiyya, yathā bhikkhū gaucaragāmaṃ viya yathāsukhaṃ piṇḍāya pavisitvā nikkhamaiyyunti|

niṭṭhitā mahāmauggal‍lānassa sīhanādakathā|

vinayapañ‍ñattiyācanakathāvaṇṇanā

18. idāni āyasmā upāli vinayapañ‍ñattiyā mūlatau pabhuti nidānaṃ dassaituṃ sāriputtatthairassa sikkhāpadapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ vitak‍kuppādaṃ dassaintau  ‘‘atha khau āyasmatau sāriputtassā’’tiādimāha| tattha rahaugatassāti rahasi gatassa| paṭisal‍līnassāti sal‍līnassa aikībhāvaṃ gatassa| katamaisānanti atītaisu vipassīādīsu buddhaisu katamaisaṃ| ciraṃ assa ṭhiti, cirā vā assa ṭhitīti ciraṭṭhitikaṃ| saisamaittha uttānapadatthamaiva|

kiṃ pana thairau imaṃ attanau parivitak‍kaṃ sayaṃ vinicchinituṃ na sak‍kautīti? vuc‍catai – sak‍kauti ca na sak‍kauti ca| ayañhi imaisaṃ nāma buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahausi, imaisaṃ ciraṭṭhitikanti aittakaṃ sak‍kauti vinicchinituṃ| iminā pana kāraṇaina na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahausi, iminā ciraṭṭhitikanti aitaṃ na sak‍kauti| mahāpadumatthairau panāha – ‘‘aitampi sauḷasavidhāya pañ‍ñāya matthakaṃ pattassa aggasāvakassa na bhāriyaṃ, sammāsambuddhaina pana saddhiṃ aikaṭṭhānai vasantassa sayaṃ vinicchayakaraṇaṃ tulaṃ chaḍḍaitvā hatthaina tulanasadisaṃ hautīti bhagavantaṃyaiva upasaṅkamitvā pucchī’’ti| athassa bhagavā taṃ vissaj‍jaintau ‘‘bhagavatau ca sāriputta vipassissā’’tiādimāha| taṃ uttānatthamaiva|

19. puna thairau kāraṇaṃ pucchantau kau nu khau, bhantai, haitūtiādimāha| tattha kau nu khau bhantaiti kāraṇapucchā, tassa katamau nu khau bhantaiti atthau| haitu pac‍cayauti ubhayamaitaṃ kāraṇādhivacanaṃ; kāraṇañhi yasmā taina tassa phalaṃ hinauti pavattati, tasmā haitūti vuc‍cati| yasmā taṃ paṭic‍ca aiti pavattati, tasmā pac‍cayauti vuc‍cati| aivaṃ atthatau aikampi vauhāravasaina ca vacanasiliṭṭhatāya ca tatra tatra aitaṃ ubhayampi vuc‍cati| saisamaittha uttānatthamaiva|

idāni  taṃ haituñ‍ca pac‍cayañ‍ca dassaituṃ ‘‘bhagavā ca sāriputta vipassī’’tiādimāha| tattha kilāsunau ahaisunti na ālasiyakilāsunau, na hi buddhānaṃ ālasiyaṃ vā ausan‍navīriyatā vā atthi| buddhā hi aikassa vā dvin‍naṃ vā sakalacak‍kavāḷassa vā dhammaṃ daisaintā samakainaiva ussāhaina dhammaṃ daisainti, na parisāya appabhāvaṃ disvā ausan‍navīriyā haunti, nāpi mahantabhāvaṃ disvā ussan‍navīriyā| yathā hi sīhau migarājā sattan‍naṃ divasānaṃ ac‍cayaina gaucarāya pak‍kantau khuddakai vā mahantai vā  pāṇai aikasadisainaiva vaigaina dhāvati| taṃ kissa haitu? ‘‘mā mai javau parihāyī’’ti| aivaṃ buddhā appakāya vā mahatiyā vā parisāya samakainaiva ussāhaina dhammaṃ daisainti| taṃ kissa haitu? ‘‘mā nau dhammagarutā parihāyī’’ti| dhammagarunau hi buddhā dhammagāravāti|

yathā pana amhākaṃ bhagavā mahāsamuddaṃ pūrayamānau viya vitthāraina dhammaṃ daisaisi, aivaṃ tai na daisaisuṃ| kasmā? sattānaṃ apparajakkhatāya| taisaṃ kira kālai dīghāyukā sattā apparajakkhā ahaisuṃ| tai catusac‍capaṭisaṃyuttaṃ aikagāthampi sutvā dhammaṃ abhisamainti, tasmā na vitthāraina dhammaṃ daisaisuṃ| tainaiva kāraṇaina appakañ‍ca naisaṃ ahausi suttaṃ…pai॰… vaidal‍lanti| tattha suttādīnaṃ nānattaṃ paṭhamasaṅgītivaṇṇanāyaṃ vuttamaiva|

apañ‍ñattaṃ sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadanti sāvakānaṃ niddausatāya dausānurūpatau pañ‍ñapaitabbaṃ sattāpattikkhandhavasaina āṇāsikkhāpadaṃ apañ‍ñattaṃ| anuddiṭṭhaṃ  pātimaukkhanti anvaddhamāsaṃ āṇāpātimaukkhaṃ anuddiṭṭhaṃ ahausi| auvādapātimaukkhamaiva tai uddisiṃsu; tampi ca nau anvaddhamāsaṃ| tathā hi vipassī bhagavā chan‍naṃ chan‍naṃ vassānaṃ sakiṃ sakiṃ auvādapātimaukkhaṃ uddisi; tañ‍ca khau sāmaṃyaiva| sāvakā panassa attanau attanau vasanaṭṭhānaisu na uddisiṃsu| sakalajambudīpai aikasmiṃyaiva ṭhānai bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā khaimai migadāyai vipassissa bhagavatau vasanaṭṭhānai sabbaupi bhikkhusaṅghau upausathaṃ akāsi| tañ‍ca khau saṅghupausathamaiva; na gaṇupausathaṃ, na puggalupausathaṃ, na pārisuddhiupausathaṃ, na adhiṭṭhānupausathaṃ|

tadā kira jambudīpai caturāsītivihārasahassāni haunti| aikamaikasmiṃ vihārai abbaukiṇṇāni dasapi vīsatipi bhikkhusahassāni vasanti, bhiyyaupi vasanti| upausathāraucikā daivatā tattha tattha gantvā āraucainti – ‘‘mārisā, aikaṃ vassaṃ atik‍kantaṃ, dvai tīṇi cattāri pañ‍ca vassāni atik‍kantāni, idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ vassaṃ, āgāminiyā puṇṇamāsiyā buddhadassanatthaṃ upausathakaraṇatthañ‍ca gantabbaṃ! sampattau vau san‍nipātakālau’’ti| tatau  sānubhāvā bhikkhū attanau attanau ānubhāvaina gacchanti, itarai daivatānubhāvaina| kathaṃ? tai kira bhikkhū pācīnasamuddantai vā pacchimauttaradakkhiṇasamuddantai vā ṭhitā gamiyavattaṃ pūraitvā pattacīvaramādāya ‘‘gacchāmā’’ti cittaṃ uppādainti; saha cittuppādā upausathaggaṃ gatāva  haunti| tai vipassiṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ abhivādaitvā nisīdanti| bhagavāpi san‍nisin‍nāya parisāya imaṃ auvādapātimaukkhaṃ uddisati|

‘‘khantī paramaṃ tapau titikkhā|

nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā|

na hi pabbajitau parūpaghātī|

na samaṇau hauti paraṃ vihaiṭhayantau||

‘‘sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalassa upasampadā|

sacittapariyaudapanaṃ, aitaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ||

‘‘anupavādau  anupaghātau, pātimaukkhai ca saṃvarau|

mattañ‍ñutā ca bhattasmiṃ, pantañ‍ca sayanāsanaṃ|

adhicittai ca āyaugau, aitaṃ buddhāna sāsana’’nti|| (dī॰ ni॰ 2.90; dha॰ pa॰ 183-185)|

aitainaiva upāyaina itaraisampi buddhānaṃ pātimaukkhuddaisau vaiditabbau| sabbabuddhānañhi imā tissauva auvādapātimaukkhagāthāyau haunti| tā dīghāyukabuddhānaṃ yāva sāsanapariyantā uddaisamāgacchanti; appāyukabuddhānaṃ paṭhamabaudhiyaṃyaiva| sikkhāpadapañ‍ñattikālatau pana pabhuti āṇāpātimaukkhamaiva uddisīyati| tañ‍ca khau bhikkhū aiva uddisanti, na buddhā| tasmā amhākampi bhagavā paṭhamabaudhiyaṃ vīsativassamattamaiva idaṃ auvādapātimaukkhaṃ uddisi| athaikadivasaṃ pubbārāmai migāramātupāsādai nisin‍nau bhikkhū āmantaisi – ‘‘na dānāhaṃ, bhikkhavai, itau paraṃ upausathaṃ karissāmi pātimaukkhaṃ uddisissāmi, tumhaiva dāni bhikkhavai itau paraṃ upausathaṃ karaiyyātha, pātimaukkhaṃ uddisaiyyātha| aṭṭhānamaitaṃ, bhikkhavai, anavakāsau yaṃ tathāgatau aparisuddhāya parisāya upausathaṃ karaiyya, pātimaukkhaṃ uddisaiyyā’’ti (cūḷava॰ 386)| tatau paṭṭhāya bhikkhū āṇāpātimaukkhaṃ uddisanti| idaṃ āṇāpātimaukkhaṃ taisaṃ anuddiṭṭhaṃ ahausi| taina vuttaṃ – ‘‘anuddiṭṭhaṃ pātimaukkha’’nti|

taisaṃ  buddhānanti taisaṃ vipassīādīnaṃ tiṇṇaṃ buddhānaṃ| antaradhānaināti khandhantaradhānaina; parinibbānaināti vuttaṃ hauti| buddhānubuddhānanti yai taisaṃ buddhānaṃ anubuddhā sammukhasāvakā taisañ‍ca khandhantaradhānaina| yai tai pacchimā sāvakāti  yai taisaṃ sammukhasāvakānaṃ santikai pabbajitā pacchimā sāvakā| nānānāmāti ‘‘buddharakkhitau, dhammarakkhitau’’tiādi nāmavasaina vividhanāmā| nānāgauttāti ‘‘gautamau, mauggal‍lānau’’tiādi gauttavasaina vividhagauttā| nānājac‍cāti ‘‘khattiyau, brāhmaṇau’’tiādijātivasaina nānājac‍cā| nānākulā pabbajitāti khattiyakulādivasai naiva uc‍canīcauḷāruḷārabhaugādikulavasaina vā vividhakulā nikkhamma pabbajitā|

tai taṃ brahmacariyanti tai pacchimā sāvakā  yasmā aikanāmā aikagauttā aikajātikā aikakulā pabbajitā ‘‘amhākaṃ sāsanaṃ tanti pavaiṇī’’ti attanau bhāraṃ katvā brahmacariyaṃ rakkhanti, ciraṃ pariyattidhammaṃ pariharanti| imai ca tādisā na haunti| tasmā añ‍ñamañ‍ñaṃ vihaiṭhaintā vilaumaṃ gaṇhantā ‘‘asukau thairau jānissati, asukau thairau jānissatī’’ti sithilaṃ karauntā taṃ brahmacariyaṃ khippañ‍ñaiva antaradhāpaisuṃ, saṅgahaṃ āraupaitvā na rakkhiṃsu| saiyyathāpīti tassatthassa aupammanidassanaṃ| vikiratīti vikkhipati| vidhamatīti ṭhānantaraṃ naiti| viddhaṃsaitīti ṭhitaṭṭhānatau apanaiti| yathā taṃ suttaina asaṅgahitattāti yathā suttaina asaṅgahitattā aganthitattā abaddhattā aivaṃ vikirati yathā suttaina asaṅgahitāni vikiriyanti, aivaṃ vikiratīti vuttaṃ hauti| aivamaiva khauti aupammasampaṭipādanaṃ| antaradhāpaisunti vaggasaṅgaha-paṇṇāsasaṅgahādīhi asaṅgaṇhantā yaṃ yaṃ attanau ruc‍cati, taṃ tadaiva gahaitvā saisaṃ vināsaisuṃ adassanaṃ nayiṃsu|

akilāsunau ca tai bhagavantau ahaisuṃ sāvakai caitasā caitau paric‍ca auvaditunti apica sāriputta tai buddhā attanau caitasā sāvakānaṃ caitau paric‍ca paricchinditvā auvadituṃ akilāsunau ahaisuṃ, paracittaṃ ñatvā anusāsaniṃ na bhāriyatau na papañ‍catau addasaṃsu| bhūtapubbaṃ sāriputtātiādi taisaṃ akilāsubhāvappakāsanatthaṃ vuttaṃ| bhiṃsanakaiti bhayānakai bhayajananakai| aivaṃ vitak‍kaithāti naikkhammavitak‍kādayau tayau vitak‍kai vitak‍kaitha| mā aivaṃ vitak‍kayitthāti kāmavitak‍kādayau tayau akusalavitak‍kai mā vitak‍kayittha| aivaṃ manasi karauthāti ‘‘anic‍caṃ dukkhamanattā asubha’’nti manasi karautha| mā aivaṃ manasā  katthāti ‘‘nic‍caṃ sukhaṃ attā subha’’nti mā manasi akarittha| idaṃ pajahathāti akusalaṃ pajahatha| idaṃ upasampaj‍ja viharathāti kusalaṃ upasampaj‍ja paṭilabhitvā nipphādaitvā viharatha|

anupādāya  āsavaihi cittāni vimuc‍ciṃsūti aggahaitvā vimuc‍ciṃsu| taisañhi cittāni yaihi āsavaihi vimuc‍ciṃsu, na tai tāni gahaitvā vimuc‍ciṃsu| anuppādaniraudhaina pana nirujjhamānā aggahaitvā vimuc‍ciṃsu| taina vuttaṃ – ‘‘anupādāya āsavaihi cittāni vimuc‍ciṃsū’’ti| sabbaipi tai arahattaṃ patvā sūriyarasmisamphuṭṭhamiva padumavanaṃ vikasitacittā ahaisuṃ| tatra sudaṃ sāriputta bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ hautīti tatrāti purimavacanāpaikkhaṃ; sudanti padapūraṇamattai nipātau; sāriputtāti ālapanaṃ| ayaṃ panaittha atthayaujanā – tatrāti yaṃ vuttaṃ ‘‘añ‍ñatarasmiṃ bhiṃsanakai vanasaṇḍai’’ti, tatra yau sau bhiṃsanakauti vanasaṇḍau vuttau, tassa bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ hauti, bhiṃsanakiriyāya hautīti atthau| kiṃ hauti? idaṃ hauti – yau kauci avītarāgau…pai॰… laumāni haṃsantīti|

atha vā tatrāti sāmiatthai bhummaṃ| suiti nipātau; ‘‘kiṃ su nāma tai bhauntau samaṇabrāhmaṇā’’tiādīsu (ma॰ ni॰ 1.469) viya| idanti adhippaitamatthaṃ pac‍cakkhaṃ viya katvā dassanavacanaṃ| suidanti sudaṃ, sandhivasaina ikāralaupau vaiditabbau| ‘‘cakkhundriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ, anañ‍ñātañ‍ñassāmītindriyaṃ (vibha॰ 219), ‘‘kiṃ sūdha vitta’’ntiādīsu (saṃ॰ ni॰ 1.73, 246; su॰ ni॰ 183) viya| ayaṃ panaittha atthayaujanā – tassa sāriputta bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ idaṃsu hauti| bhiṃsanakatasminti bhiṃsanakabhāvaiti atthau| aikassa takārassa laupau daṭṭhabbau| bhiṃsanakattasmintiyaiva vā pāṭhau| ‘‘bhiṃsanakatāya’’ iti vā vattabbai liṅgavipal‍lāsau katau| nimittatthai caitaṃ bhummavacanaṃ, tasmā aivaṃ sambandhau vaiditabbau – bhiṃsanakabhāvai idaṃsu hauti, bhiṃsanakabhāvanimittaṃ bhiṃsanakabhāvahaitu bhiṃsanakabhāvapac‍cayā idaṃsu hauti| yau kauci avītarāgau taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati, yaibhuyyaina laumāni haṃsantīti bahutarāni laumāni haṃsanti uddhaṃ mukhāni sūcisadisāni kaṇṭakasadisāni ca hutvā tiṭṭhanti, appāni na haṃsanti| bahutarānaṃ vā sattānaṃ haṃsanti| appakānaṃ atisūrapurisānaṃ na haṃsanti|

idāni  ayaṃ khau, sāriputta, haitūtiādi nigamanaṃ| yañ‍caittha antarantarā na vuttaṃ, taṃ uttānatthamaiva| tasmā pāḷik‍kamainaiva vaiditabbaṃ| yaṃ pana vuttaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahausīti, taṃ purisayugavasaina vuttanti vaiditabbaṃ| vassagaṇanāya hi vipassissa bhagavatau asītivassasahassāni āyu, sammukhasāvakānampissa tattakamaiva| aivamassa yvāyaṃ sabbapacchimakau sāvakau, taina saha ghaṭaitvā satasahassaṃ saṭṭhimattāni ca vassasahassāni brahmacariyaṃ  aṭṭhāsi| purisayugavasaina pana yugaparamparāya āgantvā dvaiyaiva purisayugāni aṭṭhāsi| tasmā na ciraṭṭhitikanti vuttaṃ| sikhissa pana bhagavatau sattativassasahassāni āyu| sammukhasāvakānampissa tattakamaiva| vaissabhussa bhagavatau saṭṭhivassasahassāni āyu| sammukhasāvakānampissa tattakamaiva| aivaṃ taisampi yai sabbapacchimakā sāvakā taihi saha ghaṭaitvā satasahassatau uddhaṃ cattālīsamattāni vīsatimattāni ca vassasahassāni brahmacariyaṃ aṭṭhāsi| purisayugavasaina pana yugaparamparāya āgantvā dvai dvaiyaiva purisayugāni aṭṭhāsi| tasmā na ciraṭṭhitikanti vuttaṃ|

20. aivaṃ āyasmā sāriputtau tiṇṇaṃ buddhānaṃ brahmacariyassa na ciraṭṭhitikāraṇaṃ sutvā itaraisaṃ tiṇṇaṃ brahmacariyassa ciraṭṭhitikāraṇaṃ sautukāmau puna bhagavantaṃ ‘‘kau pana bhantai haitū’’ti ādinā nayaina pucchi| bhagavāpissa byākāsi| taṃ sabbaṃ vuttapaṭipakkhavasaina vaiditabbaṃ| ciraṭṭhitikabhāvaipi caittha taisaṃ buddhānaṃ āyuparimāṇataupi purisayugataupi ubhayathā ciraṭṭhitikatā vaiditabbā| kakusandhassa hi bhagavatau cattālīsavassasahassāni āyu, kauṇāgamanassa bhagavatau tiṃsavassasahassāni, kassapassa bhagavatau vīsativassasahassāni; sammukhasāvakānampi naisaṃ tattakamaiva| bahūni ca naisaṃ sāvakayugāni paramparāya brahmacariyaṃ pavattaisuṃ| aivaṃ taisaṃ āyuparimāṇataupi sāvakayugataupi ubhayathā brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahausi|

amhākaṃ pana bhagavatau kassapassa bhagavatau upaḍḍhāyukappamāṇai dasavassasahassāyukakālai  uppaj‍jitabbaṃ siyā| taṃ asambhuṇantaina pañ‍cavassasahassāyukakālai, aikavassasahassāyukakālai, pañ‍cavassasatāyukakālaipi vā uppaj‍jitabbaṃ siyā| yasmā panassa buddhattakārakai dhammai aisantassa pariyaisantassa ñāṇaṃ paripācaintassa gabbhaṃ gaṇhāpaintassa vassasatāyukakālai  ñāṇaṃ paripākamagamāsi| tasmā atiparittāyukakālai uppan‍nau| tainassa sāvakaparamparāvasaina ciraṭṭhitikampi brahmacariyaṃ āyuparimāṇavasaina vassagaṇanāya naciraṭṭhitikamaivāti vattuṃ vaṭṭati|

21. atha khau āyasmā sāriputtauti kau anusandhi? aivaṃ tiṇṇaṃ buddhānaṃ brahmacariyassa ciraṭṭhitikāraṇaṃ sutvā sikkhāpadapañ‍ñattiyaiva ciraṭṭhitikabhāvahaitūti niṭṭhaṃ gantvā bhagavataupi brahmacariyassa ciraṭṭhitikabhāvaṃ icchantau āyasmā sāriputtau bhagavantaṃ sikkhāpadapañ‍ñattiṃ yāci| tassā yācanavidhidassanatthamaitaṃ vuttaṃ – atha khau āyasmā sāriputtau uṭṭhāyāsanā  …pai॰… ciraṭṭhitikanti| tattha addhaniyanti addhānakkhamaṃ; dīghakālikanti vuttaṃ hauti| saisaṃ uttānatthamaiva|

athassa bhagavā ‘‘na tāvāyaṃ sikkhāpadapañ‍ñattikālau’’ti pakāsaintau ‘‘āgamaihi tvaṃ sāriputtā’’tiādimāha| tattha āgamaihi tvanti tiṭṭha tāva tvaṃ; adhivāsaihi tāva tvanti vuttaṃ hauti| ādaratthavasainaivaittha dvikkhattuṃ vuttaṃ| aitaina bhagavā sikkhāpadapañ‍ñattiyā sāvakānaṃ visayabhāvaṃ paṭikkhipitvā ‘‘buddhavisayauva sikkhāpadapañ‍ñattī’’ti āvikarauntau ‘‘tathāgatau vā’’tiādimāha| aittha ca tatthāti sikkhāpadapañ‍ñattiyācanāpaikkhaṃ bhummavacanaṃ| tatrāyaṃ yaujanā – yaṃ vuttaṃ ‘‘sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaiyyā’’ti, tattha tassā sikkhāpadapañ‍ñattiyā tathāgatauyaiva kālaṃ jānissatīti| aivaṃ vatvā akālaṃ tāva dassaituṃ ‘‘na tāva sāriputtā’’tiādimāha|

tattha āsavā tiṭṭhanti aitaisūti āsavaṭṭhānīyā| yaisu diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikā dukkhāsavā kilaisāsavā ca parūpavādavippaṭisāravadhabandhanādayau caiva apāyadukkhavisaisabhūtā ca āsavā tiṭṭhantiyaiva, yasmā naisaṃ  tai kāraṇaṃ hauntīti atthau| tai āsavaṭṭhānīyā vītik‍kamadhammā yāva na saṅghai pātubhavanti, na tāva satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaitīti ayamaittha yaujanā| yadi hi pañ‍ñapaiyya, parūpavādā parūpārambhā garahadausā na parimuc‍caiyya|

kathaṃ? pañ‍ñapaintaina hi ‘‘yau pana bhikkhu maithunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisaivaiyyā’’tiādi sabbaṃ pañ‍ñapaitabbaṃ bhavaiyya| adisvāva vītik‍kamadausaṃ imaṃ pañ‍ñattiṃ ñatvā  parai aivaṃ upavādañ‍ca upārambhañ‍ca garahañ‍ca pavattaiyyuṃ – ‘‘kathañhi nāma samaṇau gautamau bhikkhusaṅghau mai anvāyikau vacanakarauti aittāvatā sikkhāpadaihi palivaiṭhaissati, pārājikaṃ pañ‍ñapaissati? nanu imai kulaputtā mahantaṃ bhaugakkhandhaṃ mahantañ‍ca ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ hatthagatāni ca raj‍jānipi pahāya pabbajitā, ghāsacchādanaparamatāya santuṭṭhā, sikkhāya tibbagāravā, kāyai ca jīvitai ca nirapaikkhā viharanti| taisu nāma kau laukāmisabhūtaṃ maithunaṃ vā paṭisaivissati, parabhaṇḍaṃ vā harissati, parassa vā iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ atimadhuraṃ jīvitaṃ upacchindissati, abhūtaguṇakathāya vā jīvitaṃ kappaissati! nanu pārājikai apañ‍ñattaipi pabbaj‍jāsaṅkhaipainaivaitaṃ pākaṭaṃ kata’’nti| tathāgatassa ca thāmañ‍ca balañ‍ca sattā na jānaiyyuṃ| pañ‍ñattampi sikkhāpadaṃ kuppaiyya, na yathāṭhānai tiṭṭhaiyya| saiyyathāpi nāma akusalau vaij‍jau kañ‍ci anuppan‍nagaṇḍaṃ purisaṃ pak‍kausāpaitvā ‘‘aihi bhau purisa, imasmiṃ tai sarīrappadaisai mahāgaṇḍau uppaj‍jitvā anayabyasanaṃ  pāpaissati, paṭikac‍caiva naṃ tikicchāpaihī’’ti vatvā ‘‘sādhācariya, tvaṃyaiva naṃ tikicchassū’’ti vuttau tassa araugaṃ sarīrappadaisaṃ phālaitvā lauhitaṃ nīharitvā ālaipanabandhanadhauvanādīhi taṃ padaisaṃ sañchaviṃ katvā taṃ purisaṃ vadaiyya – ‘‘mahāraugau tai mayā tikicchitau, daihi mai daiyyadhamma’’nti| sau taṃ ‘‘kimayaṃ bālavaij‍jau vadati? katarau kira mai iminā raugau tikicchitau? nanu mai ayaṃ dukkhañ‍ca janaiti, lauhitakkhayañ‍ca maṃ pāpaitī’’ti aivaṃ upavadaiyya caiva upārambhaiyya  ca garahaiyya ca, na cassa guṇaṃ jānaiyya| aivamaiva yadi anuppan‍nai vītik‍kamadausai satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaiyya, parūpavādādīhi ca na parimuc‍caiyya, na cassa thāmaṃ vā balaṃ vā sattā jānaiyyuṃ, pañ‍ñattampi sikkhāpadaṃ kuppaiyya, na yathāṭhānai tiṭṭhaiyya| tasmā vuttaṃ – ‘‘na tāva sāriputta satthā sāvakānaṃ…pai॰… pātubhavantī’’ti|

aivaṃ akālaṃ dassaitvā puna kālaṃ dassaituṃ ‘‘yatau ca khau sāriputtā’’tiādimāha| tattha yatauti yadā; yasmiṃ kālaiti vuttaṃ hauti| saisaṃ vuttānusārainaiva vaiditabbaṃ| ayaṃ vā haittha saṅkhaipatthau – yasmiṃ samayai ‘‘āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā’’ti saṅkhyaṃ gatā vītik‍kamadausā saṅghai pātubhavanti, tadā satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaiti, uddisati pātimaukkhaṃ| kasmā? taisaṃyaiva ‘‘āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā’’ti saṅkhyaṃ  gatānaṃ vītik‍kamadausānaṃ paṭighātāya| aivaṃ pañ‍ñapaintau yathā nāma kusalau vaij‍jau uppan‍naṃ gaṇḍaṃ phālanalaipanabandhanadhauvanādīhi tikicchantau raugaṃ vūpasamaitvā sañchaviṃ katvā na tvaiva upavādādirahau hauti, sakai ca ācariyakai viditānubhāvau hutvā sak‍kāraṃ pāpuṇāti; aivaṃ na ca upavādādirahau hauti, sakai ca sabbañ‍ñuvisayai viditānubhāvau hutvā sak‍kāraṃ pāpuṇāti| tañ‍cassa sikkhāpadaṃ akuppaṃ hauti, yathāṭhānai tiṭṭhatīti|

aivaṃ āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppattiṃ sikkhāpadapañ‍ñattiyā akālaṃ uppattiñ‍ca kālanti vatvā idāni taisaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppattikālañ‍ca uppattikālañ‍ca dassaituṃ ‘‘na tāva sāriputta idhaikac‍cai’’tiādimāha| tattha uttānatthāni padāni pāḷivasainaiva vaiditabbāni| ayaṃ pana anuttānapadavaṇṇanā – rattiyau jānantīti rattañ‍ñū, attanau pabbajitadivasatau paṭṭhāya bahukā rattiyau jānanti, cirapabbajitāti vuttaṃ hauti| rattañ‍ñūhi mahattaṃ rattañ‍ñumahattaṃ; cirapabbajitaihi mahantabhāvanti atthau| tatra rattañ‍ñumahattaṃ pattai saṅghai  upasainaṃ vaṅgantaputtaṃ ārabbha sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñattanti vaiditabbaṃ| sau hāyasmā ūnadasavassai bhikkhū upasampādaintai disvā aikavassau saddhivihārikaṃ upasampādaisi| atha bhagavā sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaisi – ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, ūnadasavassaina upasampādaitabbau| yau upasampādaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti (mahāva॰ 75)| aivaṃ pañ‍ñattai sikkhāpadai puna bhikkhū ‘‘dasavassāmha dasavassāmhā’’ti bālā abyattā upasampādainti| atha bhagavā aparampi sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñāpaisi – ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, bālaina abyattaina upasampādaitabbau| yau upasampādaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, byattaina bhikkhunā paṭibalaina dasavassaina vā atiraikadasavassaina vā upasampādaitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 76) rattañ‍ñumahattaṃ pattakālai dvai sikkhāpadāni pañ‍ñattāni|

vaipul‍lamahattanti vipulabhāvaina mahattaṃ| saṅghau hi yāva na thairanavamajjhimānaṃ vasaina vaipul‍lamahattaṃ pattau hauti, tāva saināsanāni pahaunti| sāsanai aikac‍cai āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā na uppaj‍janti| vaipul‍lamahattaṃ pana pattai tai uppaj‍janti| atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaiti| tattha vaipul‍lamahattaṃ pattai saṅghai pañ‍ñattasikkhāpadāni ‘‘yau pana bhikkhu anupasampan‍naina uttari dirattatirattaṃ sahasaiyyaṃ kappaiyya, pācittiyaṃ’’  (pāci॰ 51); ‘‘yā pana bhikkhunī anuvassaṃ vuṭṭhāpaiyya, pācittiyaṃ’’ (pāci॰ 1171); ‘‘yā pana bhikkhunī aikaṃ vassaṃ dvai vuṭṭhāpaiyya, pācittiya’’nti (pāci॰ 1175) iminā nayaina vaiditabbāni|

lābhaggamahattanti lābhassa aggamahattaṃ; yau lābhassa aggau uttamau mahantabhāvau, taṃ pattau hautīti atthau| lābhaina vā aggamahattampi, lābhaina saiṭṭhattañ‍ca mahantattañ‍ca pattauti atthau| saṅghau hi yāva na lābhaggamahattaṃ pattau hauti, tāva na lābhaṃ paṭic‍ca āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā uppaj‍janti| pattai pana uppaj‍janti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaiti  – ‘‘yau pana bhikkhu acailakassa vā paribbājakassa vā paribbājikāya vā sahatthā khādanīyaṃ vā bhaujanīyaṃ vā dadaiyya, pācittiya’’nti (pāci॰ 270)| idañhi lābhaggamahattaṃ pattai saṅghai sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñattaṃ|

bāhusac‍camahattanti bāhusac‍cassa mahantabhāvaṃ| saṅghau hi yāva na bāhusac‍camahattaṃ pattau hauti, tāva na āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā uppaj‍janti| bāhusac‍camahattaṃ pattai pana yasmā aikampi nikāyaṃ, dvaipi…pai॰… pañ‍capi nikāyai uggahaitvā ayaunisau ummuj‍jamānā puggalā rasaina rasaṃ saṃsanditvā uddhammaṃ ubbinayaṃ satthusāsanaṃ dīpainti| atha satthā ‘‘yau pana bhikkhu aivaṃ vadaiyya – tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ daisitaṃ ājānāmi…pai॰… samaṇuddaisaupi cai aivaṃ vadaiyyā’’tiādinā (pāci॰ 418) nayaina sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaitīti|

aivaṃ  bhagavā āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppattikālañ‍ca uppattikālañ‍ca dassaitvā tasmiṃ samayai sabbasaupi taisaṃ abhāvaṃ dassaintau ‘‘nirabbudau hi sāriputtā’’tiādimāha| tattha nirabbudauti abbudavirahitau; abbudā vuc‍canti caurā, nic‍caurauti atthau| caurāti ca imasmiṃ atthai dussīlāva adhippaitā| tai hi assamaṇāva hutvā samaṇapaṭiñ‍ñatāya paraisaṃ pac‍cayai caurainti| tasmā nirabbudauti nic‍caurau, niddussīlauti vuttaṃ hauti| nirādīnavauti nirupaddavau nirupasaggau; dussīlādīnavarahitauyaivāti vuttaṃ hauti| apagatakāḷakauti kāḷakā vuc‍canti dussīlāyaiva; tai hi suvaṇṇavaṇṇāpi samānā kāḷakadhammayaugā kāḷakātvaiva vaiditabbā| taisaṃ abhāvā apagatakāḷakau| apahatakāḷakautipi pāṭhau| suddhauti apagatakāḷakattāyaiva suddhau pariyaudātau pabhassarau| sārai patiṭṭhitauti sārau vuc‍canti sīla-samādhi-pañ‍ñāvimutti-vimuttiñāṇadassanaguṇā, tasmiṃ sārai patiṭṭhitattā sārai patiṭṭhitau|

aivaṃ sārai patiṭṭhitabhāvaṃ vatvā puna sau cassa sārai patiṭṭhitabhāvau aivaṃ vaiditabbauti dassaintau imaisañhi sāriputtāti ādimāha| tatrāyaṃ saṅkhaipavaṇṇanā – yānimāni vairañ‍jāyaṃ  vassāvāsaṃ upagatāni pañ‍ca bhikkhusatāni, imaisaṃ yau guṇavasaina pacchimakau sabbaparittaguṇau bhikkhu, sau sautāpan‍nau| sautāpan‍nauti sautaṃ āpan‍nau; sautauti ca maggassaitaṃ adhivacanaṃ| sautāpan‍nauti taina saman‍nāgatassa puggalassa| yathāha –

‘‘sautau sautauti hidaṃ, sāriputta, vuc‍cati; katamau nu khau, sāriputta, sautauti? ayamaiva hi, bhantai, ariyau aṭṭhaṅgikau maggau, saiyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi…pai॰… sammāsamādhī’’ti| ‘‘sautāpan‍nau sautāpan‍nauti hidaṃ, sāriputta, vuc‍cati; katamau nu khau, sāriputta, sautāpan‍nau’’ti? ‘‘yau hi, bhantai, iminā ariyaina aṭṭhaṅgikaina maggaina saman‍nāgatau, ayaṃ vuc‍cati – sautāpan‍nau| sauyamāyasmā aivaṃnāmau aivaṃgauttau’’ti (saṃ॰ ni॰ 5.1001)| idha pana maggaina phalassa nāmaṃ din‍naṃ| tasmā phalaṭṭhau ‘‘sautāpan‍nau’’ti vaiditabbau|

avinipātadhammauti vinipātaitīti vinipātau; nāssa vinipātau dhammauti avinipātadhammau, na attānaṃ apāyaisu vinipātanasabhāvauti vuttaṃ hauti| kasmā? yai dhammā apāyagamanīyā, taisaṃ parikkhayā| vinipatanaṃ vā vinipātau, nāssa vinipātau dhammauti avinipātadhammau, apāyaisu vinipātanasabhāvau assa natthīti vuttaṃ hauti| sammattaniyāmaina maggaina  niyatattā niyatau| sambaudhi paraṃ ayanaṃ parā gati assāti sambaudhiparāyaṇau| upari maggattayaṃ avassaṃ sampāpakauti atthau| kasmā? paṭiladdhapaṭhamamaggattāti|

vinayapañ‍ñattiyācanakathā niṭṭhitā|

buddhāciṇṇakathā

22. aivaṃ dhammasaināpatiṃ sañ‍ñāpaitvā vairañ‍jāyaṃ taṃ vassāvāsaṃ vītināmaitvā vutthavassau mahāpavāraṇāya pavāraitvā atha khau bhagavā  āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantaisi| āmantaisīti ālapi abhāsi sambaudhaisi| kinti? āciṇṇaṃ khau panaitanti aivamādi| āciṇṇanti caritaṃ vattaṃ anudhammatā| taṃ khau panaitaṃ āciṇṇaṃ duvidhaṃ hauti – buddhāciṇṇaṃ, sāvakāciṇṇanti| katamaṃ buddhāciṇṇaṃ? idaṃ tāva aikaṃ – yaihi nimantitā vassaṃ vasanti, na tai anapalaukaitvā anāpucchitvā janapadacārikaṃ pak‍kamanti| sāvakā pana apalaukaitvā vā anapalaukaitvā vā yathāsukhaṃ pak‍kamanti|

aparampi buddhāciṇṇaṃ – vutthavassā pavāraitvā janasaṅgahatthāya janapadacārikaṃ pak‍kamantiyaiva| janapadacārikaṃ carantā ca mahāmaṇḍalaṃ majjhimamaṇḍalaṃ antimamaṇḍalanti imaisaṃ tiṇṇaṃ maṇḍalānaṃ añ‍ñatarasmiṃ maṇḍalai  caranti| tattha mahāmaṇḍalaṃ navayaujanasatikaṃ, majjhimamaṇḍalaṃ chayaujanasatikaṃ, antimamaṇḍalaṃ tiyaujanasatikaṃ| yadā mahāmaṇḍalai cārikaṃ caritukāmā haunti, tadā mahāpavāraṇāya pavāraitvā pāṭipadadivasai mahābhikkhusaṅghaparivārā nikkhamitvā gāmanigamādīsu mahājanaṃ āmisapaṭiggahaina anuggaṇhantā dhammadānaina cassa vivaṭṭupanissitaṃ kusalaṃ vaḍḍhaintā navahi māsaihi janapadacārikaṃ pariyausāpainti| sacai pana antauvassai bhikkhūnaṃ samathavipassanā taruṇā haunti, mahāpavāraṇāya appavāraitvā pavāraṇāsaṅgahaṃ datvā kattikapuṇṇamāyaṃ pavāraitvā māgasirassa paṭhamadivasai mahābhikkhusaṅghaparivārā nikkhamitvā vuttanayainaiva majjhimamaṇḍalai aṭṭhahi māsaihi cārikaṃ pariyausāpainti| sacai pana naisaṃ vutthavassānaṃ aparipākindriyā vainaiyyasattā haunti, taisaṃ indriyaparipākaṃ āgamaintā māgasiramāsampi tatthaiva vasitvā phussamāsassa paṭhamadivasai mahābhikkhusaṅghaparivārā nikkhamitvā vuttanayainaiva antimamaṇḍalai sattahi māsaihi cārikaṃ pariyausāpainti| taisu ca maṇḍalaisu yattha katthaci vicarantāpi tai tai sattai kilaisaihi viyaujaintā  sautāpattiphalādīhi payaujaintā vainaiyyavasainaiva nānāvaṇṇāni pupphāni aucinantā viya caranti|

aparampi buddhānaṃ āciṇṇaṃ – daivasikaṃ pac‍cūsasamayai santaṃ sukhaṃ nibbānārammaṇaṃ katvā phalasamāpattisamāpaj‍janaṃ, phalasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā daivasikaṃ mahākaruṇāsamāpattiyā samāpaj‍janaṃ, tatau vuṭṭhahitvā dasasahassacak‍kavāḷai baudhanaiyyasattasamavalaukanaṃ|

aparampi  buddhānaṃ āciṇṇaṃ – āgantukaihi saddhiṃ paṭhamataraṃ paṭisanthārakaraṇaṃ, aṭṭhuppattivasaina dhammadaisanā, autiṇṇai dausai sikkhāpadapañ‍ñāpananti idaṃ buddhāciṇṇaṃ|

katamaṃ sāvakāciṇṇaṃ? buddhassa bhagavatau kālai dvikkhattuṃ san‍nipātau purai vassūpanāyikāya ca kammaṭṭhānaggahaṇatthaṃ, vutthavassānañ‍ca adhigataguṇāraucanatthaṃ upari kammaṭṭhānaggahaṇatthañ‍ca| idaṃ sāvakāciṇṇaṃ| idha pana buddhāciṇṇaṃ dassaintau āha – ‘‘āciṇṇaṃ khau panaitaṃ, ānanda, tathāgatāna’’nti|

āyāmāti āgaccha yāma| apalaukaissāmāti cārikaṃ caraṇatthāya āpucchissāma| aivanti sampaṭicchanatthai nipātau| bhantaiti gāravādhivacanamaitaṃ; satthunau paṭivacanadānantipi vaṭṭati| bhagavatau pac‍cassausīti bhagavatau vacanaṃ paṭiassausi, abhimukhau hutvā suṇi sampaṭicchi| aivanti iminā vacanaina paṭiggahaisīti vuttaṃ hauti|
